programme.title: Sarah Millican: Control Enthusiast

programme.title: Daddy's Home

programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay is in Wichita, Kansas, where he tries to revitalise Fetch Bistro, which offers diners a place to eat alongside their canine companions. The chef and his team have just 24 hours to update the interior and pare down the menu and teach the staff the new dishes. They plan a pared-down menu featuring new dishes and a more consistent approach, with their customers asked to come back the next day to assess the changes. What will they think of the improvements to the restaurant?

programme.title: Millionaire Hoarders
programme.desc: Expert Katie Ridges helps a woman whose assortment of period clothes has taken over her home. Notty wishes to sell some of them, so she can fund a clothes barn where she can house her collection and allow others to see and appreciate them too. Disc jockey PEP has been collecting autographs and Manchester United ephemera since he was young and has so many that he has to pay for storage to contain them all. Now, he needs to raise cash for some much-needed home renovations, so expert Clive Downham heads to Morecambe for a celeb fest-hunt

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: The culinary contest arrives in Hull as five more diners hope to claim the grand prize of £1,000. However, her guests prove to be a lively bunch, twerking their way through dinner, and throwing in a few seal impressions along the way

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.title: Ottoman Empire by Train with Alice Roberts
programme.desc: In the final leg of her expedition, Alice takes a train to Budapest, the westernmost point of the empire, and learns how close the Ottomans came to conquering all of Europe. The western terrain was perfect for the Ottomans, with vast green fields for growing food and keeping cattle, as well as Budapest's ample supply of natural springs. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team breathe new life into three cherished heirlooms, reviving wonderful memories along with the items.
First through the barn doors are Emma Brookes and her mum Rosemary, with an incredible tale of wartime resistance. They have brought in Rosemary's father's homemade radio, which he used during the Nazi occupation of Jersey during the Second World War. In an attempt to control the flow of information, the Nazis confiscated all of the radios on the island, and anyone caught using one was in serious trouble. Undeterred, Rosemary's father hid his contraption under the floorboards, removing it each day to listen to the BBC news. He would then post a news bulletin on the noticeboard at his club. It was his way of defying the Germans and doing his bit for the war effort. The radio is made from an old polish tin, curtain hooks and other bits and pieces he had to hand. Returning it to working order promises to be a tough assignment for electronics expert Mark Stuckey.
Next to arrive is Joanna Carpenter, with a set of dinner gongs that came from her gran's farmhouse. Joanna remembers playing with them as a child at dinner time and has fond memories of spending time with her grandmother, watching her feeding and milking the cows, making butter and playing the piano. Joanna's grandmother left her the gongs when she died, but sadly they no longer sound as they once did. Musical instrument expert Pete Woods needs to step up to the plate to revive these charming items.
The day's final visitor is Chloe Foster from Hampshire, with a musical carousel given to her by her mum. Chloe has cerebral palsy and was in and out of hospital as a child. Her mum bought the carousel to help keep Chloe occupied during long hospital appointments. Chloe would play it over and over, but it's been about five years since the toy last worked, and one of the horses has completely broken off. Now Chloe is an adult, she is contemplating moving out of the family home and getting her own place, and she would like to be able to put the working carousel out on display.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team restores a silver saxophone, a stained-glass window panel depicting the Blackpool Tower and a music box shaped like a grand piano. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the experts return to hear the stories of more treasured items before bringing them back to life for their owners. The other items are an Austin J40 toy pedal car, a china dog complete with its own wooden kennel and a lucky cap belonging to an avid Rotherham United fan

programme.title: The Repair Shop

Mark Stuckey tries to get a sound from an ageing and very damaged radio, and also teams up with upholsterer Sonnaz Nooranvary to work on a 1970s egg-shaped chair with enclosed speakers. programme.title: The Repair Shop

Miserable at the prospect, they decide to completely forget yuletide and go on a Caribbean cruise. But their change of plan doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: Almost Christmas
programme.desc: A retired mechanic who lost his wife a year earlier invites his daughters and sons to his house for a traditional celebration. However, it's not long before they start arguing, seemingly scuppering his chances of a happy Christmas. Comedy, starring Danny Glover, Romany Malco and Mo'Nique

programme.title: A Christmas Number One
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Freida Pinto and Iwan Rheon. A music manager and a heavy metal singer clash when the latter pens a song that could become a festive hit.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voice of James McAvoy. Santa's job of getting presents to all the children in just one night is an operation that requires military precision. But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: Seasonal fantasy comedy starring Melissa McCarthy and Paapa Essiedu. Workaholic Bernard is having a pretty bad Christmas: his wife has left him, he's been fired and he's all alone. But things take a surprising turn when he unwittingly releases a genie from a jewellery box and is granted unlimited wishes. Could Bernard be about to get his life back together?

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Black comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates. In a small American town, kindly inventor Rand Peltzer brings home a cute little animal called a mogwai for his son Billy, with three rules for its upkeep: never get the mogwai wet, expose him to light or feed him after midnight. Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. After breaking up with her boyfriend, Los Angeles workaholic Amanda is in need of a holiday. An online search persuades her to exchange her California home over Christmas for the remote Surrey cottage of journalist Iris, who has just found out her ex is getting married. But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

programme.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
programme.desc: Claire Bennett inherits Uncle Lou's beloved Christmas bar in New York and plans to sell it before Christmas. But when Zach, manager of a rival club, wants to buy it, they compete in events to attract customers. As rivalry turns to romance, Claire and Zach reconsider their priorities together. Romantic drama, starring Tamera Mowry-Housley and Kristoffer Polaha

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: Animated fantasy based on the book by Dr Seuss, featuring the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch. The embittered, mountain-dwelling Grinch plots to ruin the festive season for the cheery citizens of Whoville. That is until he finds his spirits unexpectedly lifted by a young girl and her family.

June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". But when Mom is taken to hospital, June runs off into the woods and discovers the Wonderland characters living out a gloomy existence there. Can June make everything right again?

programme.title: Dog Man

Shrek is a grumpy green ogre whose swamp is overrun with homeless traditional fairy-tale characters. To get them evicted by evil Lord Farquaad, he must rescue Princess Fiona from her dragon-guarded tower, with only a talking donkey for company.

programme.desc: Sequel to the hit animated fantasy, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. On returning from their honeymoon, Shrek and Princess Fiona are invited to stay with her parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away. But King Harold is less than enchanted by his new son-in-law, and the Fairy Godmother has good reason to want the ogre out of Fiona's life. Cue assassin-for hire Puss-in-Boots...

programme.title: Shrek the Third
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. When his father-in-law becomes ill, Shrek is expected to become ruler of Far Far Away. But the grumpy green ogre would rather live the quiet life with Princess Fiona in his beloved swamp. Travelling overseas in search of a true heir, Shrek is unaware that the pregnant Fiona is in danger from a rebellion led by jilted Prince Charming.

programme.title: Shrek Forever After
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy, the fourth adventure about the grumpy, green ogre, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Cameron Diaz and Eddie Murphy. Bored with his new-found domesticity, Shrek makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin that will allow him to return to something like his old life. Things don't go to plan, however, when Shrek finds himself in a land where ogres are hunted and he and Princess Fiona have never met.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Animated comedy musical featuring the voices of Matthew McConaughey, Scarlett Johansson and Reese Witherspoon. Buster Moon, the koala owner of a failing theatre, decides to hold a talent show to save it. However, a printing error adds two zeroes to the $1,000 prize, resulting in a stampede of contestants - and a big headache for Buster.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson, and featuring John Malkovich. When the crown jewels are stolen from under the nose of the authorities, bumbling secret agent Johnny English is assigned to retrieve them and capture the culprits. The unfortunate spy is soon in over his head when he discovers that the theft is part of an evil plan to seize the British throne.

programme.title: Johnny English Reborn
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson. When a plot comes to light to assassinate the Chinese premier, hapless operative Johnny English, currently honing his combat skills in a remote region of Tibet, is hurriedly called back to MI7.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller starring Jennifer Lawrence. In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. When her younger sister is chosen, the resourceful Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her place.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino's award-winning, multi-stranded crime drama, starring John Travolta, Samuel L Jackson and Uma Thurman. Downtown LA: lovebirds Honey Bunny and Pumpkin plan to hold up a diner. Washed-up boxer Butch is paid to throw his last fight, but has other ideas. "Fixer" the Wolf has to get hitmen Vincent and Jules out of a sticky situation. And Vincent is nervous when he has to escort his boss's wife for the night - with good reason.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Carolina Caroline
programme.desc: A young woman falls for a charismatic con man on the run, joining him on a reckless journey across the American Southeast. As their crimes grow bolder and their passion deepens, she searches for the mother who abandoned her. Crime thriller, starring Samara Weaving and Kyle Gallner

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his trusty assistant Dr Watson are once again drawn into a battle of wits with arch nemesis Professor Moriarty. And this time the evil genius's plan could spell disaster for the whole of Europe.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Drama starring Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington and Jason Robards. Andrew Beckett's career at a prestigious law firm appears to be taking off. But Beckett hasn't revealed to his employers that he is gay or that he is HIV positive. When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Fantasy prison drama based on the novel by Stephen King, starring Tom Hanks and featuring Michael Clarke Duncan. Retired warder Paul Edgecomb remembers his time in charge of death-row inmates in a Louisiana penitentiary, and the strange powers of convicted child killer John Coffey.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: The History of Sound
programme.desc: In 1917 New England, unassuming music student Lionel Worthing meets David White in a bar. There is an instant connection between men with a mutual interest in the history of folk music, and they spark a passionate affair, conducted behind closed doors. Historical drama, starring Paul Mescal, Josh O'Connor and Chris Cooper

programme.title: Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: After a whirlwind night of romance with a terminally ill man, a woman commits to helping him spend his last days living life to the fullest. Drama, starring Isabelle Fuhrman, Mena Massoud, Jennifer Grey and Kelsey Grammer. Co-written, produced and directed by Julia Stiles

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Drama starring Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington and Jason Robards. Andrew Beckett's career at a prestigious law firm appears to be taking off. But Beckett hasn't revealed to his employers that he is gay or that he is HIV positive. When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Natalie Portman and Peter Sarsgaard. A week after the assassination of her husband, President John F Kennedy, a shell-shocked Jackie is interviewed by a journalist, and is forced to relive the events leading up to the most horrific moment of her life.

programme.title: Hamnet
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Jessie Buckley and Paul Mescal. In 16th century Stratford-upon-Avon, Agnes Hathaway and aspiring playwright Will Shakespeare fall in love, marry and have three children. Over the years, Will grows increasingly absent from the family as he pursues his career in London. Eventually, the couple suffers a terrible loss that each processes separately, though Will's latest play offers possible catharsis.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Political thriller based on a true story, starring Meryl Streep and Tom Hanks. Kay Graham, publisher of The Washington Post, and editor Ben Bradlee must overcome their differences to bring the leaked Pentagon Papers - which reveal the extent of the US government's involvement in the Vietnam War - into the public eye.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Jason Biggs. The randy students return for another summer of sexual misadventures following their first year at college.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two boys bonded by their lack of popularity. When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kristen Wiig and Rose Byrne. After Lillian announces her engagement, she asks her lifelong pal Annie to be her maid of honour. However, Annie's life is in a mess, and she finds herself losing control over the bachelorette party to Lillian's seemingly perfect new friend Helen.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan. After pursuing each other through two movies, Jim and Michelle finally decide to tie the knot, but their friends' plans for a bachelor party almost derail the forthcoming nuptials.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: Black comedy action horror starring Harvey Keitel, George Clooney, Quentin Tarantino and Juliette Lewis. Fleeing the law, two murderous brothers kidnap a priest and his family, driving the priest's Winnebago south for a rendezvous at a lowlife bar in Mexico. Little do they know that the bar's staff and regulars hide a blood-drenched secret.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Comedy starring Dudley Moore, Liza Minnelli and John Gielgud. Playboy Arthur Bach spends money like water and drinks like a fish, and will flush his chances of inheritance down the drain unless he marries a respectable heiress. But, for better or for worse, Arthur falls for impoverished Linda Marolla instead.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Rodney Dangerfield, and featuring Bill Murray. A caddy gets caught up in a feud between a snooty golf club president and a vulgar millionaire who wants to buy the course for a new property development.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Comedy starring Dudley Moore, Liza Minnelli and John Gielgud. Playboy Arthur Bach spends money like water and drinks like a fish, and will flush his chances of inheritance down the drain unless he marries a respectable heiress. But, for better or for worse, Arthur falls for impoverished Linda Marolla instead.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: A stressed businessman just wants to make it home to spend Thanksgiving with his family. However, when his flight is forced to land miles from its destination, he finds himself sharing a disaster-strewn journey across America with an amiable but slobbish salesman. Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: Notting Hill

Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Superheroes
programme.desc: Never fear, your heroes are here! Join us as we soar into the action-packed worlds of our favourite superheroes, from Superman and Wonder Woman to Hulk and Madame Web.

programme.title: Snakes on a Plane

Grizzled FBI agent Neville Flynn is accompanying Mob murder witness Sean Jones on a flight from from Hawaii to Los Angeles, where Jones is due to testify against brutal crime boss Eddie Kim. But the aircraft holds a concealed cargo of lethal, aggressive reptiles.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Investigating some of nature's biggest mysteries

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Setting out to bring in new livestock and expand the range of produce, the chef plans to bring in some ducks. But things aren't as simple as they seem as Marcus heads out onto the lake to create a new home for them

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain creates some easy celebration bakes, including a glittering meringue layer cake, a slow-cooked lamb curry fit for a feast, a traditional Eastern European sweet bread known as babka and an American inspired seafood extravaganza. She also meets award-winning macaron maker Naeem Mohamed, who shares his astonishing macaron stack cake

programme.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
programme.desc: Period comedy drama based on Oscar Wilde's play, starring Rupert Everett and Colin Firth. Landowner Jack Worthing has invented a younger brother called "Ernest" so he can escape his sober existence once in a while to visit his best friend Algernon and live the high life in London. Algernon, meanwhile, his curiosity roused by Jack's stories about his ward, Cecily, sets off for Shropshire as "Ernest" to meet the young lady.

programme.title: Strangers on a Train
programme.desc: Classic Hitchcock thriller starring Farley Granger, Ruth Roman and Robert Walker. An obsessive playboy strikes up a conversation with a tennis player he encounters on a train. The playboy, who hates his father, reveals to the sportsman that he knows of his wife's refusal to grant him a divorce and proposes a double murder to solve both their problems.

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Broadcasting legend Bob Harris and queen of motor sports Suzi Perry compete in a battle of antiques, while travelling across south east England. They're joined by Margie Cooper and Raj Bisram, both veteran road trippers and rivals to the core. Bob falls for a pair of champagne flutes in a love heart stand, while Suzy steps back in time when she discovers a Japanese glass fishing float

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: Second World War adventure starring Michael Caine, Donald Sutherland and Robert Duvall. In November 1943, the military authorities in Berlin receive a simple message, "The Eagle Has Landed". It is the start of a daring attempt by a small force of crack German paratroopers to kidnap the British prime minister, Winston Churchill.

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 3

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2

programme.desc: Disney's classic animated tale. A young deer grows up in the woods where he befriends lots of other animals, including Thumper the rabbit. When tragedy strikes, Bambi must learn some life lessons fast if he is going to live up to his inherited title of "Prince of the Forest".

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: Adaptation of JM Barrie's classic fantasy adventure, starring Jason Isaacs, Jeremy Sumpter and Rachel Hurd-Wood. London, the early 1900s: young Wendy Darling is visited by a boy with the ability to fly who persuades her and her brothers to join him on an adventure to the magical world of Neverland. There they encounter the evil Captain Hook and the jealous fairy Tinker Bell.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Piper Perabo, featuring the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia. While on holiday in Mexico, a pampered pooch gets lost and is captured by an unscrupulous dognapper.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: Animated fairy tale from Pixar, featuring the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly. Merida, a tomboy Scottish princess, flees the court after her parents insist she should settle down and get married. However, when the errant teenager encounters a witch in the woods and asks her to cast a spell to change the situation, it sets off a chaotic chain of events that only Merida's bravery and archery skills can reverse.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan and Sean Bean. A school trip to a museum takes an unexpected turn for teenager Percy Jackson when he is revealed to be the son of Greek god Poseidon. He is immediately plunged into a quest to retrieve a lightning bolt belonging to Zeus and prevent a divine war.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans. The bookish daughter of a clockmaker embarks on a dangerous quest when her father becomes lost in the woods, and discovers a Gothic castle that is home to a fearsome beast and his magically cursed servants. Can Belle learn to love the beast and break the spell?

programme.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Chris Pratt and Zoe Saldana. A rag-tag gang of unlikely bedfellows - including a wisecracking rogue, a warrior princess, a talking raccoon and a sentient tree - join together to save the universe.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure prequel starring Alden Ehrenreich. Han Solo falls in with a group of smugglers who, after a rocky start, enlist the young pilot to help with the theft of some coaxium fuel. But although Han is crafty enough to make allies, there is much dangerous double-crossing among the galaxy's criminal underworld.

programme.title: Naked Attraction's Best Naughty Bits
programme.desc: A look at back at the rich tapestry of the show's pickers, from the people who shared all their darkest secrets to the time when a polyamorous couple picked a date on the show. This episode also catch up with some of our most memorable pickers, including Emmy-Lou and Glynn

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on the revamped Gladiators, get loved up with First Dates: Be My Valentine, and give their unmissable takes on the movie Saltburn. Plus: Trigger Point, Bring the Drama, The Repair Shop, This Morning and BBC News coverage of President Joe Biden. First shown in February 2024

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: Jacob and Gregory head out on a double date, but when they run into some familiar faces, it proves to be an unfortunate distraction. Meanwhile, Ava's first book club meeting turns into a debate over who would be the best post-apocalyptic leader

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A loner and falconry expert arrives in town and saves Bart from the school bullies, leading the two to become great friends. Before long, however, the spiky-haired tearaway realises his new pal is not so much eccentric as out-and-out disturbed. With the guest voice of Harry Potter star Daniel Radcliffe

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Erica thinks that all her singing dreams are about to come true when she lands a job at the new karaoke bar in town. However, when she is tasked with bringing in more customers, she is forced to ask Beverly for help. Meanwhile, Murray tries to teach Barry and Lainey how to be financially responsible adults. Rick Springfield guest stars

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: When Adam tells Beverly that he doesn't want her to chaperone the school trip to a theme park, his mother attempts to manipulate him with 'guilt letters'. After attending a career night, Geoff realises he doesn't want to be an eye doctor like his father

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil is unable to hide his excitement when he's invited to appear in a real-estate segment for the local news and the day gets even better after meeting his weatherman hero Rainer Shine (guest star Nathan Fillion). Meanwhile, Jay decides to infuse a little grit into Manny's video interview for his college application, and Lily decides to take matters into her own hands over her new house guest

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Luke's Halloween party isn't the monster bash he dreamed of and is at risk of having the worst party of the year. Sensing trouble, the rest of the Dunphy's realize all his party needs is a visit from Rod Skyhook, a little promotion and some adult supervision to get it started. Meanwhile at the Tucker-Pritchett home, Cam faces off with his Halloween nemesis while Lily and Mitchell try to save the day and work to keep him from going to the darkside. Finally, when Jay finds out that Manny is going to a party at the home of an old enemy, he enlists him to deliver a trick he will never forget.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Mitchell is thrown into the spotlight when Cam fails to fill him in on what his play is really about, while Phil threatens to spoil Jay's favourite place in the world when he considers becoming a member

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited
programme.desc: It's Vegas baby! Groom Simon and best man Anthony sit down and pore over the decisions that led to Simon gambling it all on THAT explosive Las Vegas wedding to bride Kayleigh.

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
programme.desc: Comedy clips showcasing amusing internet videos, featuring ducks going up an escalator, animal impressions, and a few narrow escapes on a snowboard and rally driving

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Billy believes the sty's the limit as he plans a pig-themed wedding, wanting to use the occasion to put his village Mansfield Woodhouse on the map with a world-record pig parade. Wheher his prim and proper bride Steph will kick up a stink remains to be seen

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Aussie-born Adam is taking a risk planning an '80s Aussie soap' wedding when bride-to-be Rachel is hoping for something classy and sophisticated

programme.title: Made in Chelsea
programme.desc: Beks learns the truth from Freddy about the lovebite on his neck. Will Jazz's moment of comfort with Inga affect her relationship with Eve? And Tristan turns to James Taylor for advice

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chef Gordon Ramsay heads to Charlie's Italian bistro in La Verne, southern California, where the owner's lack of business nous is putting her relatives' homes at risk, after her mother and sister put them up as collateral. To make matters worse, the restaurant's food is less than appetising and its long-serving chef seems to be incompetent

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay's next stop is Philadelphia, where family run restaurant Chiarella's is struggling to survive in an area full of thriving Italian eateries. Tommy and Dina Defino's marriage is on the verge of collapse and his sense of personal failure only adds to the troubles of their crisis-ridden business

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay's next stop is Philadelphia, where family run restaurant Chiarella's is struggling to survive in an area full of thriving Italian eateries. Tommy and Dina Defino's marriage is on the verge of collapse and his sense of personal failure only adds to the troubles of their crisis-ridden business

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits three previous restaurants he tried to save, finding out whether they stayed on the road to recovery or turned back into nightmares. First he heads for West Babylon, New York, where he helped the inexperienced owners of restaurant Classic American deal with their escalating debts, before returning to Davide in Boston, an Italian restaurant run by two warring brothers. Finally, he visits Down City, a restaurant in Providence, Rhode Island, run by hot-headed owner Abby

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits four restaurants he earlier tried to save, finding out whether they stayed on the road to recovery or fell by the wayside. First he visits the Spanish Pavillion in New Jersey, then heads to California to see the owners of Kingston Cafe, French-themed La Frite, and Capri

programme.title: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Cena. Fireman Jake Carson and his team rescue three headstrong children from a burning cabin and must look after them until their parents can be found.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Bart develops a crush on babysitter Laura Powers and plots to break up her relationship with bullying boyfriend Jimbo Jones - but things do not turn out as planned. Featuring the voice of Sara Gilbert (Roseanne, The Big Bang Theory)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer's new snowplough business proves an unexpected success but drives a wedge between him and Barney, who decides to operate a rival service. Featuring the voices of Linda Ronstadt and Adam West

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The family wonders when Maggie will say her first word, which prompts Marge to reminisce about Lisa's early days and how a two-year-old Bart suffered a serious outbreak of sibling jealousy. Featuring the guest voice of Elizabeth Taylor

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer has a heart attack but cannot afford proper medical care, so dodgy doctor Nick Riviera offers to perform a cut-price triple-bypass operation. Cartoon capers, with the voices of Dan Castellaneta and Hank Azaria

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge sets out to halt the plans of an unscrupulous businessman intending to defraud Springfield's residents by supplying them with a defective monorail system. Featuring the guest voice of Leonard Nimoy

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Selma decides to take her Aunt Gladys's advice and start a family - but a day in charge of Bart and Lisa at a beer-themed amusement park soon changes her mind

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Bart perform street magic in a bid to impress passers-by and raise enough cash to pay a mechanic's bill. Unfortunately, they quickly realise people are suckers for a sob story, and start conning the public for money. Featuring the guest voice of Edward Norton

programme.title: The Great Christmas Bake Off
programme.desc: Matt Lucas and Noel Fielding present a festive special featuring five contestants from classic Channel 4 programmes. Gaby Roslin (The Big Breakfast), Tony Robinson (Time Team), Miquita Oliver (Popworld), Terry Christian (The Word) and Claire Sweeney (Brookside) are the ones competing for the title of Christmas Star Baker - and hoping for a Hollywood handshake along the way. As a special treat, the show ends with a performance by the English National Ballet

programme.title: Gogglebox Festive Special
programme.desc: The armchair critics cast their eyes over Christmas TV shows for 2023. Programmes under scrutiny include The Real Full Monty: Jingle Bells, Squid Game: The Challenge, An Audience with Kylie, The Repair Shop Christmas Special, Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One, Planet Earth, Men Up, The 1% Club Christmas Special, Fur Babies and Love Actually

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including Britain's Got Talent, Married at First Sight Australia, Chess Masters: The Endgame, The Au Pair, This Morning, The Americas, Inside the Four Seasons Park Lane and With Love, Meghan

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including The Great Celebrity Bake Off for Stand Up to Cancer, With Love Meghan, Tempting Fortune, Fear, Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code, Last One Laughing, Jeopardy and a This Morning feature on toenails. From March 2025

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Period horror starring Mia Goth. In 1918, Texas farm girl Pearl yearns to be a star of stage and screen, but her strict mother disapproves of such dreams. When Pearl hears about a local audition for a touring dance troupe, her single-minded ambition bubbles over into a rage that proves murderous.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Jessie Buckley and Rory Kinnear. Following a personal tragedy, Londoner Harper drives out to the Hereford countryside for a spot of rest and recovery. However, Harper soon realises that everyone in her orbit is a man, each with the same face, and while some of these figures are harmless, others might be very dangerous indeed.

programme.title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet
programme.desc: Animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Trevor White. When accident-prone explorer Tad unleashes an ancient spell, he embarks on a globe-trotting adventure to release his friends from its shape-shifting effects.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring James Marsden, Jim Carrey and the voice of Ben Schwartz. Hunted for his incredible powers, super speedy alien Sonic lives a lonely life in hiding on Earth. When he accidentally causes a power surge, Sonic is thrown into the orbit of kindly local sheriff Tom - but also that of unhinged scientist Dr Robotnik.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Comedy from the co-director of Airplane!, starring John Cleese, Whoopi Goldberg and Cuba Gooding Jr. Anything goes when an eccentric Las Vegas billionaire sends a group of underachieving strangers on a race to retrieve $2 million from a locker in New Mexico.

programme.title: Spies in Disguise
programme.desc: Animated spy comedy featuring the voices of Will Smith and Tom Holland. After inadvertently ingesting a secret formula invented by young scientist Walter Beckett, arrogant super spy Lance Sterling finds himself turned into a pigeon. The newly feathered agent teams up with Walter to foil a terrorist plot - and work out how to get back to his suave human form.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg. Bartender and petty thief Nathan Drake is recruited by veteran explorer Victor Sullivan for a globe-trotting mission to recover treasure supposedly buried by Ferdinand Magellan 500 years ago.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Linden, 15, is brought to A&E having badly cut his leg while back-flipping off a shed roof onto a trampoline. As well as calling an ambulance, his friends filmed the accident on their mobile phones and happily show the clip to the staff at King's. Junior doctor Sammy looks after 88-year-old Panayiota, who has been referred to hospital with breathing difficulties. Originally from Cyprus, the patient speaks very little English and Sammy has to contact a translator to help with the diagnosis and treatment. Meanwhile, 55-year-old lorry driver Antony has lost all feeling in his left leg, and an ultrasound scan reveals he needs emergency surgery on a blocked artery to save his limb

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: It's a busy Mother's Day at south London's King's College Hospital as 23-year-old builder Jamie is rushed in by paramedics having fallen from the roof of a three-storey building, landing on a brick wall. The team performs an emergency ultrasound to determine whether he has suffered internal injuries or fractured his ribs and spine, and spot a punctured lung that needs to be reinflated. Four-month-old Weston has been brought to paediatric A&E after suffering from diarrhoea and vomiting for more than 24 hours, while doctors suspect David, 74, has had a stroke. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Dolls Amy and David are the treasured possessions of 36-year-old Special Olympics gold medallist Jess Hiles, first given to her when she was five. Now, with missing limbs and tired bodies they need rejuvenating, so Amanda Middleditch, Julie Tatchell and Dominic Chinea are tasked to see what they can do. A beaten-up 1950s drum kit with magical memories, a painted German toy box, and the oldest ever item to enter the barn also receive some much-needed attention. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team breathe new life into three cherished heirlooms, reviving wonderful memories along with the items.
First through the barn doors are Emma Brookes and her mum Rosemary, with an incredible tale of wartime resistance. They have brought in Rosemary's father's homemade radio, which he used during the Nazi occupation of Jersey during the Second World War. In an attempt to control the flow of information, the Nazis confiscated all of the radios on the island, and anyone caught using one was in serious trouble. Undeterred, Rosemary's father hid his contraption under the floorboards, removing it each day to listen to the BBC news. He would then post a news bulletin on the noticeboard at his club. It was his way of defying the Germans and doing his bit for the war effort. The radio is made from an old polish tin, curtain hooks and other bits and pieces he had to hand. Returning it to working order promises to be a tough assignment for electronics expert Mark Stuckey.
Next to arrive is Joanna Carpenter, with a set of dinner gongs that came from her gran's farmhouse. Joanna remembers playing with them as a child at dinner time and has fond memories of spending time with her grandmother, watching her feeding and milking the cows, making butter and playing the piano. Joanna's grandmother left her the gongs when she died, but sadly they no longer sound as they once did. Musical instrument expert Pete Woods needs to step up to the plate to revive these charming items.
The day's final visitor is Chloe Foster from Hampshire, with a musical carousel given to her by her mum. Chloe has cerebral palsy and was in and out of hospital as a child. Her mum bought the carousel to help keep Chloe occupied during long hospital appointments. Chloe would play it over and over, but it's been about five years since the toy last worked, and one of the horses has completely broken off. Now Chloe is an adult, she is contemplating moving out of the family home and getting her own place, and she would like to be able to put the working carousel out on display.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team restores a silver saxophone, a stained-glass window panel depicting the Blackpool Tower and a music box shaped like a grand piano. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the experts return to hear the stories of more treasured items before bringing them back to life for their owners. Horologist Steve Fletcher gets his hands on the largest timepiece he has ever attempted to restore in the barn, a one-of-a-kind clock built by the owner's father for a display at the World Trade Centre in Dallas. The other items are an Austin J40 toy pedal car, a china dog complete with its own wooden kennel and a lucky cap belonging to an avid Rotherham United fan

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Bookbinder Chris Shaw needs all his skills when he is presented with a Jewish prayer book that originally belonged to the owner's Austrian grandparents, and was kept by them throughout their time at Theresienstadt concentration camp in the Czech Republic. Mark Stuckey tries to get a sound from an ageing and very damaged radio, and also teams up with upholsterer Sonnaz Nooranvary to work on a 1970s egg-shaped chair with enclosed speakers. Plus, owner Ramzi Al-Nayazi brings in a treasured horse racing game from his childhood in Iraq

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Brenton West and Will Kirk set to work on Olympic diver Jack Laugher's gold and silver medals, along with their wooden cases, which have taken a battering over the years, while Steve Fletcher turns his attention to a precious musical jewellery box that was bought by Barry for his wife Bernadette while he was in Malaysia with the British Army more than 50 years ago. Amanda Middleditch and Julie Tatchell are next to be called into action, this time against a mythical monster in need of some TLC, and metal worker Dominic Chinea is handed a complicated fix on a simple tool

programme.title: The Repair Shop Jubilee Special
programme.desc: Jay Blades and the team mark the year of the Queen's Platinum Jubilee by bringing four treasured heirlooms, each with a royal connection, back to life. Amongst the items is an unfinished Pearly Suit belonging to a woman's late father, who was a Pearly King, and a hand-painted commemorative plate made to celebrate the Golden Jubilee of Queen Victoria in 1887

programme.title: Mammals

programme.title: How to Catch a Serial Killer
programme.desc:
The investigation into Christopher Halliwell by Detective Steve Fulcher has been one of the biggest crime stories in recent years, captivating the public's attention. Spanning more than a decade, multiple murders, two highly-publicized trials, and one irreparably damaged career, it is a story of the dogged pursuit of a serial killer by a police officer determined to get justice. From the moment the case of a missing 21-year-old girl named Sian O'Callaghan landed on the desk of DCI Fulcher, the hunt was on. Over the following five days came a game of cat-and-mouse of the utmost stakes, characterized by the relentless pursuit of a killer by a seasoned detective with decades on the force.
Some flashing lights sequences or patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.

He sets off on a 10,000-mile journey from the west to the east, to explore the vast swathe of islands that are scattered beyond America's shores. The first port of call on his journey is Hawaii, and his exploration looks beyond its image as a tourist paradise, crammed with sun-kissed beaches and world-class surfing, and into the havoc wreaked by advancing lava fields and smoking craters. programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 2
programme.desc: Another deep dive into the BBC's music archive, pointing the musical compass away from Top of the Pops on a quest to uncover 40 hidden gems. The songs are familiar but the performances may not be, such as Bronski Beat singing Smalltown Boy for the first time on the BBC, Rihanna's rockier version of Umbrella, Sophie Ellis-Bextor covering Pulp's Do You Remember the First Time? and Kate Bush pairing up for a tango during Hounds of Love

programme.title: 40 Hidden Music Treasures at the BBC: Volume 1
programme.desc: Expect the unexpected on this journey through the BBC's archive, which includes surprising songs and rare performances taken from shows that may have been forgotten. Featuring appearances by Jimi Hendrix, MC Hammer, Dusty Springfield, Tammy Wynette, the Beach Boys, Pet Shop Boys and John Martyn backed by Phil Collins

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling, Ella Eyre and Princess and Junior Andre continue their 7,500km race. The third leg sees the teams leave behind the ancient jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail. But with the end of Ramadan fast approaching, the teams must negotiate the crowds heading home for Eid al-Fitr

programme.title: Bill's Included
programme.desc: When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates - Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James - but when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, he has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Comedy, starring Rob Brydon

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest national and international stories as they break

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: In a special edition from North Sutherland, Dougie Vipond steps out into a vast expanse of blanket peat bog known as the Flow Country, charting the changes in its land use and its recent designation as a Unesco world heritage site. Arlene Stuart catches up with Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture, and Leanna Fernandez meets biologists working to protect precious sea trout populations at Loch Hope

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted
programme.desc: A look at gardens and gardeners who are growing in the far corners of Scotland. From battling with the elements on the tip of Sutherland to a sub-tropical garden paradise in the Borders and growing with no soil, across the bridge over the Atlantic on the Island of Seil these gardens and gardeners are all gardening on the very edges of Scotland

programme.title: A Cook Abroad: Tony Singh's India
programme.desc: Edinburgh chef Tony Singh travels to the state of Punjab to trace his family's roots and discover whether his mum's Punjabi cooking is authentic. He visits Amritsar during the festival of Diwali, receives an exclusive invitation to eat and cook with a maharajah and meets the Nihang, an order of nomadic Sikh warriors. Tony discovers how the Sikh religion and the Punjab's troubled past have created a food and culture like no other, and ends his epic adventure at his ancestral home in New Delhi with his 93-year-old uncle

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress learns about the art of patisserie in Paris, which is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world, sampling the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and a dahlia

programme.title: The Man Who Never Was
programme.desc: Second World War spy drama based on on a true story, starring Clifton Webb. Spring, 1943: as the Allies plan to invade Europe through Sicily, they must deceive the enemy into expecting the attack elsewhere. So Lieutenant Commander Montagu proposes a daring and ingenious plan.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Harthill, Scotland, Martel Maxwell encounters a house with a safety order attached to it, which means certain rooms cannot be accessed. Owain Wyn Evans heads to south Wales to see a sizeable unit with lots of development potential. Meanwhile, in Lincolnshire, Dion Dublin does all he can to escape the rain

programme.title: MOTD Live: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Arsenal v West Ham United (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the match between the London rivals at Emirates Stadium. Arsenal made a disappointing start to the season by their own high standards, but will be expecting to claim three points against a team they thrashed 5-0 in last season's corresponding fixture, with Chloe Kelly scoring a hat-trick

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Longleat in Wiltshire, where expert Claire Rawle spots an unusual Tibetan teapot among the offerings brought in for valuation and it leads to the discovery of similar artefacts. The goods all go under the hammer and with worldwide interest on the objects, there is the potential for a record-breaking sale. Meanwhile, Paul explores Longleat House to find out more about its Elizabethan architecture and controversial creator

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The teams enter Australia, where the language barriers may have disappeared - only to have been replaced by financial difficulties for all four pairs. Princess and Junior Andre raise funds by herding cattle in the Outback, while Sam Ryder and friend Kaz try to boost their funds working at an avocado farm. Jeff Stelling is in unfamiliar territory when he and son Matt stay at a backpackers' hostel and Ella Eyre and Nana head to the coastal wetlands, where they sleep just a few hundred metres from saltwater crocodiles

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: A calf is discovered without a mother on the Isle of Vallay, leaving Carianne to locate the missing mother and reunite them. In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are heading to the hills to help any cheviot sheep in need of a midwife, and in South Ayrshire, the Barclay family work round the clock to ensure their flock of beltex ewes safely deliver this year's crop of lambs

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva takes a boat trip down the Seine with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsay Shapiro to explore the story of French gastronomy through a seven-course fine-dining meal. At the heart of this tale is Auguste Escoffier, who invented and improved hundreds of classic dishes, revolutionised front of house. and put French haute cuisine on the global map

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Part two of two. The second leg of Simon's journey begins at the Giant's Causeway, before visiting a kelp farm on Rathlin Island. He heads to the Dark Hedges in Co Antrim, one of the filming locations from Game of Thrones, and visits Belfast for the July 12 parades, discovering how the event has divided the city. He also learns more about Oliver Cromwell's influence on Ireland, attends the Gaze film festival, and meets monkeys at an animal sanctuary in the Wicklow mountains

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul travel to Co Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill Murray, but with his brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together, but by the time they reach Cruit Island in Co Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry

programme.title: Uncanny
programme.desc: Danny Robins returns to investigate more reports of supernatural activity, beginning with a family experiencing terrifying events in their new-build house on the Isle of Thanet in Kent. For years they lived there happily, but then suddenly their quiet lives were rocked by repeated footsteps every night, door handles that moved by themselves, and the appearance of a cloaked, hunched shadowy figure

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Oscar-winning horror mystery starring Daniel Kaluuya and Allison Williams. Chris, a young African-American photographer, is understandably anxious when he's invited to stay with his wealthy white girlfriend's parents at their family estate. Admitting she hasn't told them he's black only adds to Chris's apprehension, but mum and dad are warm and welcoming. However, as the weekend unfolds, Chris begins to suspect all is not as it seems.

programme.title: English Football League Highlights
programme.desc: Action from the latest matches, including Middlesbrough v Bristol City at Riverside Stadium, Swansea City v West Bromwich Albion at Swansea.com Stadium and West Ham United v Preston North End at London Stadium

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: Following the departure of Will Davenport, Grantchester has a new vicar in the form of Alphy Kottaram but Geordie manages to get off on the wrong foot with him. The pair soon find themselves teaming up to investigate the murder of a local landowner

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: The Fletchers are back at the Royal Cheshire Show, but this year they're swapping the show ring for trading. For Marnie and her lamb, Hope, it's an emotional journey towards their debut in the Young Handlers class. First-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: The chef's culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands, where he takes a tour of the grounds and cooks venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden. Later, James gets a masterclass in Highland gaming as two young brothers David and Harry share the secrets to the famous caber toss

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: In a rugby-themed show, James cooks for former England player Maggie Alphonsi and ITV Sport's chief presenter Mark Pougatch. Chef Doug Crampton and baker Richard Bertinet are also in the kitchen and gardening expert David Domeney talks growing and nurturing apples

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Joining Alan at Manor Farm this time are Chelsea Detective stars Adrian Scarborough and Vanessa Emme, and farmers Kelvin and Liz Fletcher. The pygmy goats make a return to the farm, and vintage racing cars take centre stage on our driveway. Plus, Tom Surgery has pudding-inspired cocktails

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: Burnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars
programme.desc: Ben Shephard asks the questions as Mark Benton, Alex Jones and Shivi Ramoutar answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
programme.desc: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: Fantasy musical starring Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande-Butera. Elphaba Thropp is an outcast among the citizens of Oz due to her green skin and magical powers. When she arrives at the prestigious Shiz University, she is given a chance to develop her abilities and finds an unlikely friend in the popular Galinda. But something's rotten in the state of Oz, and the two young women arrive at a crossroads from which there'll be no turning back.

programme.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
programme.desc: Ant and Dec present as familiar faces begin week two in the Australian jungle, surviving on basic rations, facing trials for food and hoping to remain contenders for the crown

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
programme.desc: Chizzy Akudolu returns with the panel show, with Jonathan Ross, Gbemi Oladipo, Sukh Ojla and Remel London joining captains Richard Blackwood and Eddie Kadi. The teams battle it out over four rounds with subjects ranging from guessing why unknown faces from history should be famous to uncovering a treasure trove of facts about Africa

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Outlier: Manager Idol: Luton Town - The Football Revolution
programme.desc: Documentary telling the story of the only manager in British football to ever be appointed by a phone vote after a chairman was inspired by Pop Idol in a bid to win over fans during a summer where the money men and fans went to battle for control of Luton Town FC

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kristen Stewart. December 1991: Diana, Princess of Wales, arrives at Sandringham to mark Christmas with the royal family. Ignored by her husband, treated coldly by her in-laws, and subjected to a torrent of media attention, the former Lady Spencer begins to reckon with the realities of her situation and her marriage.

programme.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: In Hermosa Beach, California, Gordon Ramsay visits Patrick Molloy's, a family owned Irish pub. Gordon and his team have just 24 hours to completely strip out and refurbish the dining room, giving it a new, open floor plan, modern lighting and cohesive decor. They create a simplified and delicious menu, working around the clock to give Patrick's staff the face-to-face training and extra confidence they need. The patrons are asked to return the following day to sample the food and see the improvements

programme.title: I Am Helen
programme.desc: Nicola Coughlan stars in the latest instalment of Dominic Savage's drama anthology. Helen and Steve seem to have a loving relationship, but as Steve begins to consume misogynistic online porn and the rhetoric of the manosphere, their sexual dynamic shifts from mutual desire to coercive aggression. When Helen asserts her independence, Steve proves unable to reconcile his fantasy of dominance with a partner who refuses to submit

programme.title: I Am Helen
programme.desc: Concluding the two-part drama, written and directed by Dominic Savage. Alone in a hotel room, Helen discovers she is pregnant, turning her newfound clarity on her relationship into a storm of urgency and fear. The days that follow become a terrifying unravelling, and when she tries to leave Steve, his façade collapses and he turns violent. Nicola Coughlan and Joe Cole star

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Documentary set inside Woodgreen animal charity. Londoners Roshni and Jay meet two very different dogs - Bella the confident, playful Staffie, and Cech the shy but cuddly terrier.
