programme.title: Krampus
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Adam Scott and Toni Collette. When a young boy becomes disenchanted with everything that Christmas stands for, he inadvertently summons up the demonic opposite to Santa Claus who unleashes terror upon his family.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. A year on from their victory, Katniss and Peeta embark on a winners' tour of the districts. But before they leave, they are issued with a stark warning by President Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Justin Long and Jason Lee. Singing sensations Alvin, Simon and Theodore have to put aside their glittering career to face up to the reality of studying. But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
programme.desc: When Gabby's prized dollhouse ends up with eccentric cat lady Vera, the youngster embarks on a adventure to reunite the Gabby Cats and retrieve her beloved diorama before it's too late. Comedy adventure, starring Laila Lockhart Kraner and Kristen Wiig

programme.title: The Bad Guys 2
programme.desc: Struggling to adjust to their newly minted lives as Good Guys, the Bad Guys are offered one last job by a group of all-female criminals. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Sam Rockwell, Marc Maron and Craig Robinson

programme.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scientists!
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman Animations, featuring the voices of Hugh Grant, David Tennant and Martin Freeman. Pirate Captain may be the leader of a shambolic crew of buccaneers but he's still determined to win the coveted Pirate of the Year competition, even if it means fighting off fearsome rivals Black Bellamy, Peg-Leg Hastings and Cutlass Liz to see who can amass the most booty.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: Four misfits are yanked through a strange portal into a cubic realm powered by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules and journey alongside an unlikely master crafter. Director Jared Hess's blockbusting fantasy adventure based on the hit videogame, starring Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Emma Myers and Jennifer Coolidge

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: Comedy, inspired by the 1970s TV series, starring Shelley Long and Gary Cole. Los Angeles in 1995: the community is crumbling and the crime rate is spiralling out of control. In the middle of all this, the Brady bunch - mum, dad and six children - live a happy and idyllic existence, caught in a time warp of 1970s values. But the family is in danger of losing the house, so it's up to the kids to pull together and raise the $20,000 needed to save their home.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and Ricardo Montalban. In the 23rd century, Admiral James T Kirk is a guest aboard the Enterprise, which is taking part in a training exercise. But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure based on the popular TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The captain and crew of the untested new starship Enterprise travel to the desolate world of Nimbus III after a Vulcan mystic kidnaps a group of Federation diplomats. There, they find themselves caught up in a dangerous quest.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Generations
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and featuring William Shatner. When an evil alien threatens to destroy a star system along with millions of lives, Captain Jean-Luc Picard travels into a time vortex to enlist the help of his famous predecessor, James T Kirk.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Patrick Stewart. During a Federation encounter with the Borg, a sphere escapes into the Earth's past via a temporal vortex. Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise take up the challenge to pursue the Federation's most fearsome enemy and stop them from changing the future.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and Jonathan Frakes. The planet Ba'ku holds magical properties that keep the population young and living in harmony. So when an alien race attempts to take over this paradise, it falls to Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet and its people.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On their much anticipated road trip to America's notorious Area 51, two sci-fi geeks find themselves in the company of a real-life extraterrestrial who needs their help.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Jamie Foxx. Peter Parker just wants to hang out with his girlfriend but is burdened with having to save New York from a new electrically-charged enemy. Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker. Disgraced cop Brian O'Conner is given the chance to redeem himself by going under cover to entrap a powerful Miami drugs baron.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Kal-El, one of the last survivors of the planet Krypton, attempts to protect the people of Earth from evil genius Lex Luthor. Superman is assisted by the Justice Gang, comprising Guy Gardner, aka Green Lantern, Kendra Saunders, aka Hawkgirl, Michael Holt, aka Mister Terrific and Rex Mason, aka Metamorpho. Writer/director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult

programme.title: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller in which Vin Diesel and Paul Walker, the stars of the first film in the street-racing franchise, team up again. Criminal Dominic Toretto returns to LA to avenge the murder of one of his friends by a drug kingpin, bringing him face to face with an old rival - FBI agent Brian O'Conner.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller in which Vin Diesel and Paul Walker, the stars of the first film in the street-racing franchise, team up again. Criminal Dominic Toretto returns to LA to avenge the murder of one of his friends by a drug kingpin, bringing him face to face with an old rival - FBI agent Brian O'Conner.

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: All Is True
programme.desc: Period drama starring Kenneth Branagh, Judi Dench and Ian McKellen. In 1613, following the destruction of the Globe Theatre, William Shakespeare retires to Stratford-upon-Avon. Though his decades-long absence has left him estranged from his wife and daughters, the Bard attempts to settle down and repair his relationship with his family. However, he remains haunted by the death of his son Hamnet 17 years prior.

programme.title: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
programme.desc: An eight-year-old girl experiences life on her family's Rhodesian farm during the final stages of the Bush War. Drama, written, directed by and starring Embeth Davidtz, with Lexi Ventner and Zikhona Bali

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Catherine Earnshaw is raised by her alcoholic father at a Yorkshire farmhouse, with Nelly Dean as a constant companion. Mr Earnshaw 'acquires' an orphaned boy named Heathcliff during one of his gallivants and gifts the waif to Cathy as her pet. The children become inseparable, and as adults they embark on a destructive relationship. Writer-director Emerald Fennell's drama based on Emily Bronte's romance, starring Margot Robbie, Jacob Elordi and Martin Clunes

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: Suspense thriller starring Morgan Freeman. Following the abduction of a senator's daughter, psychological profiler Alex Cross is forced to join the hunt when he's contacted by the kidnapper. Working closely with the agent responsible for security at the girl's school, Cross uncovers a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

Wright's hope is that his apprehensive colleagues will be able to revive him after he flatlines. But they aren't prepared for what they discover on the other side.

Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy sequel starring Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones. When evil alien queen Serleena threatens Earth's safety, former intergalactic secret agent Kay holds the secret to her destruction. However, Kay is now living a civilian life as a post-office worker and his memory of the past has been erased. Can his former partner Jay persuade him to rejoin the sharp-suited Men in Black and save the world?

Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

Fleeing the law, two murderous brothers kidnap a priest and his family, driving the priest's Winnebago south for a rendezvous at a lowlife bar in Mexico. Little do they know that the bar's staff and regulars hide a blood-drenched secret.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: Oscar-winning historical drama directed by and starring Mel Gibson. Scotland at the end of the 13th century: the young William Wallace sees his father and brother killed by the English. Later, when his sworn enemies execute his wife, Wallace leads the clans in the fight for Scottish independence.

programme.desc: Biographical war drama starring Sam Waterston, Dr Haing S Ngor and John Malkovich. Cambodia, 1973: American journalist Sydney Schanberg and his guide Dith Pran are operating out of the war-torn ruins of Phnom Penh. When the Khmer Rouge armies enter the city, foreign reporters find themselves the target of hatred and are rounded up, facing the prospect of possible execution.

The Squirrels learn that there are certain dos and don'ts that you must follow in order to avoid mess or getting hurt, but that you can still have fun along the way.
Knowing why they should listen to these rules helps them understand their importance - if you spill your drink, someone could slip, and leftover crumbs can attract unwelcome guests. The Squirrels take turns suggesting their dos and don'ts, but some are a bit more niche than others. But most importantly, they remember that you do have fun with your friends!

programme.title: Hey Duggee

This encourages them to learn more about the natural environment, and they discover how to do this responsibly with Duggee's five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don't interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet.
The Squirrels embark on their own individual discoveries outside in rivers, the sea, mountains, the jungle and the desert. They learn how to spot an animal's disguise, better known as its camouflage. They see how birds may try to impress one another, which is in stark contrast to how a horned lizard uses its body to warn other creatures off. A fascinating look at nature!

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: A powerful gangster maintains his control over the underworld through bribing high-ranking police officials and politicians. When a new police inspector is assigned to bring him to justice, he feels sure he can corrupt the man - but when his efforts fail, he realises he must destroy the principled detective utterly. Crime drama, starring Dharmendra and Amrish Puri

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good/for/nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: A wealthy young man falls in love with a woman who hates rich people, so he pretends to be poor to gain her affection

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Alba Today
programme.desc: BBC Alba joins Radio nan Gàidheal, the BBC's Gaelic language radio service

programme.title: Alba Today
programme.desc: BBC Alba joins Radio nan Gàidheal, the BBC's Gaelic language radio service

programme.title: Daolag-bhreac is Seillean (Ladybird & Bee)
programme.desc: Daolag-bhreac is excited by the latest place he has visited. It just seems amazing

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc:
Tha Mossy air bhioran gus a charaid ùr, Fred, a thoirt gu cruinneachaidh-cluich an sgioba. Ge-tà 's e deargann a th' ann am Fred 's chan eil càch cho toilichte a leithid fhaicinn nam measg... gus an seall Fred g' eil e feumail na dhòigh fhèin!
Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today's playdate, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea! However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc:
Tha bràmair aig Bernie 's tha i gus tighinn gu dìnnear a-nochd! Ge-tà, chan eil dad a dh'fhios aig Bernie dè chuireas e air dòigh! Tha Oona 's Baba ag aontachadh a chuideachadh ach, le Mossy nam meag, saoil am bi biadh air fhàgail mus nochd i?
Bernie has a girlfriend - and she's on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her! Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Fuigheag anticipates a birthday treat, but things don’t work out as they should

programme.title: Losgannan/Froglets
programme.desc:
Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a' dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich.
Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag (Pompon Little Bear)
programme.desc:
Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh "glan" gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan?
Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Angela Mackay reads Rionnag ann an Sileagan. written and illustrated by Sam Hay and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald

programme.title: Spongebob
programme.desc:
Mr. Krabs makes Larry the Lobster temporary manager.
Tha Mgr. Crùbag a' cur Laraidh os cionn an taigh-bìdh rè ùine.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Mrs MacArthur unearths a new talent in her art class. Mr Hobson is not so sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that's behind the artwork. Meanwhile, Mr Mackle is busy with a new health kick

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Flix is eager to hang out and help out at the Tiger Milk Café, when Munchkin's parents leave him in charge for a few hours

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: The Ugly Pageant is staged, where participants decide who the ugliest Bògais is

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: When Bonns is out finding food for his 12-course midnight snack, the Cnuimhean catch and kidnap him

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: A journey throughout Scotland to discover the history and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan producers of woven fabrics

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop meets Gaelic learner Sophie Day from Falkirk, and Calum Maclean keeps a keen eye on the tide while on the hunt for spectacular cave art on Davaar Island in the Mull of Kintyre

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Eight Pretenders play from the comfort of their own homes while Kerry and Katie, and Benjamin and Calum in the studio attempt to beat them for a chance to win a cash prize

programme.title: Trusadh - Lan-sgur fuil-miosa/Menopause
programme.desc: Broadcaster Cathy Macdonald meets women at different stages of their journey to find out just what it means to go through menopause today

programme.title: An Clò Mòr
programme.desc: The locals organise a ceilidh for Old Mary who is recovering from her mill accident. A drunken Boyd confronts Mairead and Cairistiona. Things turn sour between Johan and Murdina resulting in a mysterious fire starting at the hotel

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon learns about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia’s attack on Ukraine in 2022 the border has closed completely, transforming the lives of people on both sides. In Finland, Ramsay hears the stories of families who have been separated from their loved ones on the other side, meets those responsible for securing the border and hears from people who have lost their livelihood overnight because of its closure

programme.title: Skipinnish aig a' Chaisteal (Shorts)
programme.desc: Skipinnish perform Alba and Nelson Mandela in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of Skipinnish, from Edinburgh Castle

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. The timing isn't perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie's reality TV appearance

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. After breaking up with her boyfriend, Los Angeles workaholic Amanda is in need of a holiday. An online search persuades her to exchange her California home over Christmas for the remote Surrey cottage of journalist Iris, who has just found out her ex is getting married. But the transatlantic swap soon leads to more romantic entanglements for the two women.

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show
programme.desc: Together on Graham's sofa are Hollywood legend Robert De Niro and comedy great Ben Stiller, reunited in Focker-in-Law; Oscar winner Michelle Yeoh, talking about her new TV series Bladerunner 2099; and top chef Jamie Oliver, whose latest book is 20-Minute Meals. With music from Take That, performing their current single, Higher

programme.desc: Denise van Outen joins the team as they fight back against the scammers targeting the UK. Joining presenters Rav Wilding, Nick Stapleton and reporter Harleen Nottay, the actress and presenter tracks down the scammers trading on her name to con people out of money and helps victims pick up the pieces after their brush with the criminals

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When one of Nottingham's oldest businesses is broken into, staff member Becca turns Miss Marple and manages to crack the case. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan shows two residents of the doorbell detective neighbourhood the elaborate lengths thieves will go to, to get their hands on your stuff. And Matt also hears from two friends whose life savings disappeared overnight when their food truck was stolen.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman is in Gloucestershire with Sam and Mandy, who are moving from a harbour town in Devon and making a fresh start in the countryside, with their two much-loved dogs coming along for the adventure. Nicki also gets an invitation to experience horticulture on a truly regal scale when she visits a garden quite literally fit for a king

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay are in Dumfries and Galloway, where they help with a project to commemorate the victims of the Lockerbie bombing. Will is also joined by new automata expert Michael to tackle a clockwork train that was once the pride and joy of its owner's father and Kirsten learns the secrets of medieval slipware pottery from a pair of experts in the nearby village of Corsack

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Amanda, Jamie, Iain, Namita and Chris race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: Tim Renkow welcomes comedians Janine Harouni and Stuart Goldsmith to perform their stand-up routines on London's Hammersmith Apollo stage

programme.title: Suzie Lee's Great Food Made Simple
programme.desc: Suzie is inspired by the food at Tully Mill in Fermanagh, she makes some pressed pork belly and chocolate brownies

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: Cult mystery thriller starring Kyle MacLachlan, Isabella Rossellini, Dennis Hopper and Laura Dern. Jeffrey Beaumont's corner of small-town America is a pretty and peaceful place. But not far below the idyllic surface lies a dark and violent world, upon which young Jeffrey stumbles when following the trail of a severed ear.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce hosts the topical debate, with a panel of politicians and other guests facing questions from the audience in Exeter

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha is annoyed after Kurt takes all the credit for locating Kamilla, and vows to gain access to the scientist alone. Friedrich is ordered to ramp up his efforts to locate Greta, believing she is the key to the Hermann Metzl case. Eager for a win, Martha attempts to insinuate their way into Friedrich's confidence, and steals a prized possession

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Eric Knowles hosts as uncle and niece Russ and Lily on the red team and twin sisters Angie and Tamsin on the blue team scour an antiques fair in Southwell, Nottinghamshire for items to sell for profit at auction. With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars and a marcasite brooch catches the sisters' attention

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. With a loss of sea ice, many animals are now weakening, driving animals to adapt in surprising ways, from green sea urchins using discarded shells as sun hats to common seals moving further north, only to provide unfamiliar prey for a young polar bear

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Manchester United at Anfield and Hull City v Brighton & Hove Albion at MKM Stadium. United did the double over their rivals last term for the first time since the 2015/16 season, but have struggled for form so far this term. Elsewhere, the high-flying Seagulls took on a Hull side who had acquitted themselves well to life back in the top flight. Plus, a round-up of yesterday's goals

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: A team of family and friends, Amy, JP, Nic and Alan, take on the Bridge of Lies, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies. Hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Londonderry's Walled City Market. Briony-May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese productions, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo sets off from Tynemouth on the first leg of a trip to Berwick-upon-Tweed, hearing about of a 19th-century tragedy at sea that inspired 140 local men to set up a coastal rescue service. At Long Sands beach, Michael rolls up his sleeves to help volunteers caring for sick and injured seals at the Tynemouth Aquarium Seal Hospital

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: Storm Arwen hits the UK and the skippers have tough decisions to make. Boats start to roll in the North Sea, putting Victory Rose and Our Lass at risk of collision. Skipper Darren has just three days of crabbing time before the storm pushes the boat back to the harbour and George Jack considers venturing in to the storm in search of a new species of prawn

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team pay a return visit to Coughton Court in Warwickshire. Among the finds brought in by the public are a letter from Agatha Christie, a medal awarded to those who came to the aid of the Titanic survivors, and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon travel to the Oxford Union, where they pick out antiques and collectibles to be sold at a local auction - including an autograph book and some etchings by a famous artist. Plus, Paul goes behind the scenes at the venue, to discover which famous faces debated in the chamber

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen is joined by Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad, who compete in a series of fun trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor chats to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition, while Friday's all-star panel look back at the weekend action from the Tower Ballroom in Blackpool

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Plus, new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences, whlle BBC Urdu joins women in Pakistan challenging traditional barriers by taking to the road on motorbikes, gaining new independence in a country where riding has long been considered off-limits to many women

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie invites four more contestants to brave the black chair, from which they answer questions on their specialist subjects of actress Marilyn Monroe, author Katherine Mansfield, award-winning TV series The Sopranos and German mathematician Carl Friedrich Gauss. They are then tested on their general knowledge

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts as the Six Sevens take on Meat and Two Veg for a place in the quarter-finals. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects Toe Martin, Shadow Fury, Tonsil Draper, and Jiminy Stokes

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: Amol Rajan asks the questions as the second round of the student quiz continues, with the University of Bristol pitting their wits against near neighbours the University of Bath for a place in the quarter-finals

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: The historian uncovers the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there, beginning by travelling to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages

programme.title: Ceolta
programme.desc: Fiachna Ó Braonáin and Eve Belle introduce a selection of traditional music from the Court House in Bangor, Co Down, featuring 1990s rockers Hothouse Flowers. Also taking to the stage are And So I Watch You From Afar and Winnie Ama. In Irish

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day, presented by Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: Blood
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Paul Bettany and Stephen Graham. When the prime suspect in the murder of a schoolgirl is released, two sibling cops decide to emulate their retired police chief father by doling out their own form of retribution. But their actions are destined to come back to haunt them.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Asia Trade
programme.desc: Live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping markets

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: Your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. Hosted by Yvonne Man and David Ingles.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin

Bride-to-be Ola has been dreaming of a small, intimate occasion, so Raphael's double-feature idea might come as a shock, but if the big day is to get off the ground, the laid-back groom must overcome his habit of leaving everything to the last minute - including the booking of a suitable church

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Romantically hopeless groom-to-be Dan has three weeks and £12,000 to plan the perfect wedding for his future wife Kate. He wants to prove he can be romantic by pulling off a dramatic wedding hundreds of miles away in Italy. However, his vision is worlds away from Kate's dream of a traditional fairy tale wedding surrounded by family and friends

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: At California's Huntington Beach, Darrell's insider information looks set to increase his ability to make a profit. Mary's find cooks up some oversized accoutrements, while Kenny takes advantage of others' missteps to grab a unit

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Brandi and Jarrod find their way back to the auction with the help of some pocket technology. Casey bails herself out despite being confined with an infectious German, while Ivy scoops up finds. Darrell seems set to lose his title 'The King of Montebello'

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: The chairman and CEO of a New Jersey-based company providing chauffeured luxury transportation goes to work among his own staff by posing as a contestant in a reality show. David Seelinger believes that the quality of customer care helps maintain a company's reputation, and wants to make sure his firm is on the right track for the future

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Robert Powells, co-founder and president of Rocket Fizz Soda Pop and Candy Shops, the largest fizzy drink and sweet shop franchise in America, dons a disguise to go undercover in his own company. The California-based firm has experienced rapid growth and with that comes the responsibility to make sure it stays on track as it gets bigger, so Robert is keen to find out more about the challenges the organisation faces

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Family friendly laughs, including a dog that keeps stealing a man's golf ball during putting practice, pranks that spectularly backfire and mishaps with horses

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The buyers get wind of some interesting units in Santa Clarita. Ivy and Isaiah chose quantity over quality - and it pays off. Brandi gets fancy sneaking a unit from everyone else, while Kenny finds himself searching for his soul sister

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Kenny tries to reclaim the title of King of Whittier, but has trouble amassing any shillings. Ivy and Ivy brave the cold to find their fortunes. Lisa finally graduates to fully-fledged buyer, finding an unlikely mentor along the way

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: A choppy charter has the guests reaching for sick buckets. The deck team commit yet another error - and this time it's a big one. Bri and Harry assess their relationship

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets a stubborn owner who doesn't react well to criticism. Tom bought the restaurant for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he's still refusing to let her run it. Can the chef break Tom's iron grip on the business and persuade him to change his outdated approach?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California, and within minutes of his arrival, is caught in the crossfire of an argument between the owner, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working seven days a week. Can the chef save the business and mend the warring family's frayed relationships?

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown Christmas Special
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy panel show's version of the words and numbers quiz, with Sean Lock and Kathy Burke teaming up against Jon Richardson and David Mitchell. James Acaster joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while maths whizz Rachel Riley and comedian Joe Wilkinson are in charge of the numbers

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with team captain Sean Lock and Johnny Vegas taking on guest captain Alan Carr and Lou Sanders. Lexicographer Susie Dent is joined by the Brett Domino Trio to adjudicate in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: Taskmaster

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: At Golitha Falls, where the River Fowey tumbles down to the sea, Rick meets Dawn French, who has made Cornwall her home. In the shadow of Devonport Dockyard, he boards the world's busiest chain ferry to cross the wide River Tamar, the ancient watery boundary between Devon and Cornwall - along the way discovering an unusual event involving circus elephant. And he meets a man who thinks he has discovered the next superfood, which Rick used to cook up a delicious duck dish

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick heads into the county's china clay pits to discover what is known locally as white gold, one of its most important industries. He then climbs the Cornish Alps, huge slag heaps created by the clay mining and some of Cornwall's highest land. After a wild swim at one of Cornwall's picturesque hidden coves, Rick cooks a simple sea bass recipe, revealing how to make the perfect mayonnaise. In the far west of the county, on the Land's End peninsula, Rick meets his niece, a modern artist, who explains her deep spiritual connection to Cornwall

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the post-war British modern art movement in the seaside town of St Ives, the home for leading artists such as Barbara Hepworth and Terry Frost. programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads to Northern Ireland's spectacular Causeway coast to begin a new journey, which takes him along the north and east coasts through Ulster and Leinster. He begins in Co Derry on the windswept shores of Loch Foyle, where the largest accumulation of coastal sands in Ireland has formed a system of dunes visible from space. He also learns how scientists are monitoring the site and hears how their work has been picked up by fellow scientists in the United States to help research the surface of Mars

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in the glens of Antrim, where he is transfixed by tales of fairies and legends of the sea. At the entrance to Belfast Lough in Whitehead he discovers a museum which tells the story of Ireland's railway heritage. He also sees if he has what it takes to join the local rowing club. At the medieval Carrickfergus Castle, Michael learns of the town's important role in the history of Ireland, when William of Orange landed at its harbour and went on to fight the Battle of the Boyne, which is commemorated by Unionists to this day

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys

programme.title: Blood
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Paul Bettany and Stephen Graham. When the prime suspect in the murder of a schoolgirl is released, two sibling cops decide to emulate their retired police chief father by doling out their own form of retribution. But their actions are destined to come back to haunt them.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police investigate the disappearance of a young monk from a monastery on a remote private island in Orkney and the mystery deepens when there appears to be no evidence of how he could have left the island. In Aviemore, a rock festival erupts into violence, while campers in Fort William take a wrong turn and officers are on the hunt for a suspect after a woman is attacked in an Inverness cemetery

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal reunite for the first time in decades, revisiting the rivalries and rows that shaped their careers. Each serves an iconic dish for the others to taste as they reflect on British dining's transformation and whether wounds can heal-or competition defines them

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Philip Serrell and Kate Bliss help the teams in the mid-Wales town of Builth Wells, and Danny Sebastian learns about a unique family business which immortalises Welsh icons in clay

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Amanda, Jamie, Iain, Namita and Chris race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: Clive visits the district of Vedado, the most modern and affluent part of Havana. He takes a motorcycle tour with Ernesto Guevara, Che Guevara's son and finds out how to cook a feast under rationing. Plus, Clive stretches himself with a lesson in ballet at Carlos Acosta's school and learns how to make a Cuban cocktail

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell host the quiz as first-round losers the Marvins and Merseyside Eyes return to compete for a place in the next round, with the loser being knocked out. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects lop, urve, cheron, and actrian camel humps

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Leanne, Jenny, Louise and Lauralee compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Edith Bowman and Colin Murray explore the Nairn Show to find tips and treats among the food stalls, including how to spot the perfect egg and how to choose the juiciest berries. Baker Briony-May Williams discovers bargains when using an app designed to reduce food waste, farmer Meinir Howells gets to grips with turning rapeseed into oil in Rhuthin, and chef Suzie Lee finds out whether there's such a thing as a healthy bacon sandwich.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads from Newcastle to Lynemouth, and is intrigued to hear of its part in Newcastle's early industrial development. En route, Michael travels through the huge Northumberland coalfield and, at Cramlington, he alights to visit an extraordinary work of landform art made from the spoil of a coalmine, the vast Northumberlandia, known as the Lady of the North

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: Liz explores the natural wonders of the region and its remarkable ecosystems, encountering its wildlife and meeting inspiring local conservationists. She begins in the Greater Antilles, where people are learning to forge a new relationship with the animals that inhabit this wild terrain. On the island of Hispaniola in the Dominican Republic, she helps residents of the tiny village of Los Limones scale a 60ft palm tree to retrieve a Ridgeway's hawk chick at risk of a deadly parasitic infection

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team travel to Sydney, Australia, to value artefacts and rarities on the other side of the world. Among items brought in are part of the keel of Captain Cook's ship Endeavour, furniture made by convicts transported to the country during the 18th century, and a collection of opera star Maria Callas memorabilia - which receives one of the highest valuations ever given on the programme

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team search for valuable finds in Ashridge House, Hertfordshire, joined by antiqus experts Claire Rawle and Thomas Plant, who set their sights on a Susie Cooper charger and a Royal Worcester coffee set. Paul also explores the history of the venue and discovers a colourful past filled with illustrious lodgers, including Queen Elizabeth I

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is back with more backstage gossip and behind-the-scenes action from the world of Strictly as she chats to some of the couples. Also, Anton Du Beke swings by for a chat about all things Blackpool

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: Dave Myers and Si King are in north-west Wales, discovering a host of inspiring local producers who typify the area's rich diversify. They meet Maggie, a Nigerian kitchen goddess whose spicy West African dishes are heating up the village of Penygroes, and Steff, whose love of travel inspired him to open his own speciality coffee shop 10 years ago. There are also visits to farmers Matt and Jenny, who grow food by replicating the ecosystems found in the wild, and a bakery that produces Kurdish pasties

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police race to a Skye hotel after a barman is violently assaulted, but the suspect has fled and officers must track him down. In Inverness, police prepare to raid a house suspected of links to a Liverpool drugs gang, while on the Western Isles, officers race to a reported home invasion in a remote village, only to discover that all is not as it seems

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig is joined by Alex Brooker, Bella Hull, Jamali Maddix and Alan Davies for an X-rated edition of the extended version of the quiz

programme.title: Pointless Celebrities
programme.desc: Kéllé Bryan, Kimberly Wyatt, Shazia Mirza, Thanyia Moore, Louisa Lytton, Danielle Harold, Ollie Proudlock and Caspar Lee take part in the general knowledge quiz, trying to come up with the least likely correct answers to a series of questions posed to members of the public. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Richard Osman

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal reunite for the first time in decades, revisiting the rivalries and rows that shaped their careers. Each serves an iconic dish for the others to taste as they reflect on British dining's transformation and whether wounds can heal-or competition defines them

programme.title: Love Cheats
programme.desc: When Rhode Island resident Bridget meets clean-cut 'military veteran' Ricky Morrisey on Facebook Dating, she thinks she's found her perfect match. They bond over family and Ricky's deep devotion to his dog, as he quickly sweeps her off her feet and soon moves into her home. But behind the loving façade, and his emotional stories of a fallen army buddy, lies a predator who gradually drains Bridget's finances, and Bridget joins forces with Orlando-based victim Jeannie to uncover the truth

programme.title: Walter Presents: Mademoiselle Holmes
programme.desc: French crime drama, starring Lola Dewaere as a modern-day descendant of Sherlock Holmes. Charlie and Samy stumble upon a body in the street. Everything suggests a natural death but Charlie's instinct pushes her to follow the trail of cat scratches covering the corpse. In French

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In the first of a two-part edition, Gordon Ramsay heads to La Galleria 33 in Boston, Massachusetts, an Italian restaurant run by sisters Rita and Lisa. The pair grew up working at their father's eatery nearby, but when they opened their own business, they couldn't replicate his success, and they now blame their failure on everything from the weather to the tablecloths

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples from east Kent host dinner parties, with the highest-scoring duo winning the cash prize of £1,000. Outspoken estate agent Sean and his girlfriend Beth kick off the competition with a Welsh-themed menu. Day two sees Marcus and Miguel lay on a Malaysian feast, but Sean's teasing of his girlfriend steals the limelight. Finally it's Geoff and Jill's chance to shine with their hippy vibe and Indian themed menu, so it's a battle of the curries. But whether their blend of spices and loved-up atmosphere is enough to bag them the grand remains to be seen

programme.title: Hitler's DNA: Blueprint of a Dictator
programme.desc: Part two of two. The team discover that Hitler may have had a genetic mutation that causes a medical condition called Kallmann Syndrome, which disrupts the development of sex organs. Turi King and the team make several extraordinary genetic discoveries concerning Hitler's high likelihood of suffering from schizophrenia and bipolar disorder

programme.title: Unreported World
programme.desc: Ciaran Jenkins travels to Chengdu to explore China's often contradictory food and body culture, where technology makes indulgent eating easier than ever, while social media celebrates extreme thinness. Ciaran meets food influencers celebrating sumptuous eating, and so-called 'thinfluencers' promoting the ultra-slim ideal that many young women feel pressured to emulate

programme.title: Sunday Brunch
programme.desc: Highlights of the food and chat show, with Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer

programme.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
programme.desc: Tony snaps at Dee Dee, who continues to act up, and Abigail rushes out of a staff meeting after a worrying call. And alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's... Meanwhile, Jack and Pearl plan their big day, there's a tense showdown between Imran and Ste, and Sienna has a proposition for her overlapping family tree... Writers: Colin O'Donnell, Omar Khan, Alanna Hallum; Dir: Alan de Pellette; Prod Co: Lime PicturesShort: Alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's. Jack and Pearl plan their big day. And there's a tense showdown between Imran and Ste.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasier proves to be a complete disaster as a children's party clown and Sam falls for the daughter of a former girlfriend. American comedy, starring Kelsey Grammer and Ted Danson

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca panics when her boss's dog runs away while in her care.

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Carrie clashes with the staff at an Italian restaurant and forbids Doug from ever going back there - but he just cannot resist their food. Meanwhile, Arthur prepares for an appearance on TV. Comedy, starring Kevin James

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Arthur is picked for jury duty, while Carrie is disappointed with Doug, who sends her flowers and chocolates - but only after she has reminded him of the lack of romance in their relationship

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: When she ends up on a holiday of Doug's choosing, Carrie makes sure he'll be as miserable as her by inviting Arthur along...

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra finally cooks a dish that Ray, Robert and Frank all enjoy, but Marie is not impressed with her efforts

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray and Debra plan to get more time to themselves by encouraging Marie and Frank to make new friends

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra pleads with Ray to allow her some time to herself without the family. But Marie is suspicious of her daughter-in-law, and Ray ends up spying on her.

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Self-important 'corkmaster' Niles arranges a boycott of Frasier's new radio show on wine appreciation, while Martin struggles to escape the powerful clutches of his new physiotherapist - until he samples her delicious cooking. Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce star

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Daphne breezes back into Niles's life, sparking off an argument and casting a shadow over his chances of finding romantic fulfilment. Comedy, starring David Hyde Pierce and Jane Leeves

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Daphne tries to convince Niles she is psychic, while Frasier's former college professor and mentor comes to visit, and immediately forms a romantic attachment with Roz. Comedy, guest starring Rene Auberjonois (Star Trek: Deep Space Nine), with Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Part one of two. The Seattle shrink agrees to escort Lana, his former high-school prom queen, to her surprise birthday party - but his ultimate goal is actually to spend time with her attractive friend Claire.
