programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Thriller starring Ben Affleck and Charlize Theron. When ex-con Rudy Duncan impersonates a former cellmate who has apparently been killed in prison, it leads him into a dangerous game involving the dead man's beautiful pen friend and her ruthless brother.

programme.title: Last Train to Christmas
programme.desc: Tony Towers, a successful nightclub manager and local celebrity, embarks upon the 3:17 to Nottingham for a Christmas family reunion in 1985, but things soon get a little strange. Moving up a carriage to the buffet car lands him in 1995, where he finds his clubs have failed and his life has fallen apart. Tony discovers that by moving up and down this fateful train, he can transport himself forward and backward to various stages of his life. Not only that, but the actions he takes in one carriage directly affect his life in the next. Festive drama, starring Michael Sheen and Nathalie Emmanuel

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: My Christmas Cowboy
programme.desc: After a humiliating college audition, Meg builds a career producing news in Texas. Former crush Billy, now a disgraced Hollywood host, returns home for Christmas. When Meg's injured father asks Billy to host the ranch's Reindeer Roundup, riding lessons rekindle resentment and affection, helping them discover confidence and possibly love. Romantic drama, starring Amy Acker and Luke Macfarlane

programme.title: The Night Before Christmas In Wonderland
programme.desc: Animated musical fantasy featuring the voices of Gerard Butler and Emilia Clarke. When St Nick receives a letter from the Princess of Hearts in Wonderland, he assembles his reindeer and flies down the rabbit hole to the topsy-turvy realm. But when he arrives, he falls foul of a grumpy queen who has banned Christmas. Can he cheer her up and persuade her to change her mind?

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voice of James McAvoy. Santa's job of getting presents to all the children in just one night is an operation that requires military precision. But when a glitch in the system means that a little girl is not going to get her new bike, it falls to Santa's clumsy son Arthur to make sure she isn't disappointed.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: Seasonal fantasy comedy starring Melissa McCarthy and Paapa Essiedu. Workaholic Bernard is having a pretty bad Christmas: his wife has left him, he's been fired and he's all alone. But things take a surprising turn when he unwittingly releases a genie from a jewellery box and is granted unlimited wishes. Could Bernard be about to get his life back together?

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Reese Witherspoon and Vince Vaughn. The potent mix of Christmas and relations presents a special challenge for Kate and Brad, who are forced to visit all of their four divorced parents on Christmas Day. Along the way they discover things about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Black comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates. In a small American town, kindly inventor Rand Peltzer brings home a cute little animal called a mogwai for his son Billy, with three rules for its upkeep: never get the mogwai wet, expose him to light or feed him after midnight. Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: Love Actually
programme.desc: Ensemble romantic comedy featuring Hugh Grant, Emma Thompson, Alan Rickman, Keira Knightley and Bill Nighy. In London, during the weeks leading up to Christmas, people from various walks of life - among them adult film performers, a washed-up rock star and the British Prime Minister - suffer the emotional highs and lows of being in love.

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Freeman. Despite being traumatised by a bad review years earlier, primary school teacher Paul Maddens is tasked with directing the annual Nativity play. Taunted by a teacher from a rival school, Paul foolishly promises that an old flame, now a Hollywood producer, is coming to see his production.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring Chevy Chase and Beverly D'Angelo. The accident-prone Griswold family decides to spend a traditional Christmas at home. But the peace is shattered when the decorations start to go up and the relatives arrive.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Emilia Clarke, Henry Golding and Emma Thompson. London, 2017: life could be better for twenty-something chaos magnet Kate, who has her heart set on being a singer but works all year round as an elf in a Covent Garden store. Then she meets too-good-to-be true Tom. Could romance be in the air?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Justin Long and Jason Lee. Singing sensations Alvin, Simon and Theodore have to put aside their glittering career to face up to the reality of studying. But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, featuring the voices of Martin Lawrence and Ashton Kutcher. In a tranquil mountain town, domesticated grizzly bear Boog enjoys an idyllic life as the star of a wildlife show. But when he meets hyperactive deer Elliot, he gets into so much trouble that his keeper decides it's time to release him back into the wild. Problem is, hunting season is fast approaching and there's a tenacious hunter who's determined to bag both Boog and Elliot.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Misguided inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that can turn water into food. But what initially seems like the answer to his community's economic crisis soon begins to cause some unexpected problems.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy with the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Flint Lockwood's mutating machine is no longer turning water into food but producing food/animal hybrids, or foodimals, which very quickly overrun his home town.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig and Trey Parker. Having already acquired a wife and three orphan daughters, reformed supervillain Gru now discovers that he has a long-lost twin, Dru. But Dru is hoping he can convince his brother to return to his wicked ways...

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Sandra Bullock. The film charts the history of the diminutive yellow sidekicks as they seek to serve the biggest villains around - everyone from Dracula to Napoleon, all the way up to their introduction to Gru, their evil leader in Despicable Me.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Alec Baldwin. When a seven-year-old boy discovers that his baby brother is a spy on a secret mission, he joins forces with his suit-wearing, briefcase-carrying sibling to defeat an evil businessman.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Sylvester Stallone and Gene Hackman. In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Will Smith and Martin Lawrence. When a figure from the past returns and targets detective Mike Lowery for assassination, he and partner Marcus Burnett are forced to fight back - curtailing Burnett's retirement plans. But things aren't all they seem, and it gradually becomes clear that Lowery may have an even deeper connection with their assailant.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jason Statham. A troubled former soldier on the run from a court martial assumes another man's identity and goes into hiding on the streets of London. But the desire to avenge injustice is something he can never leave behind.

programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Alexander Skarsgård, Samuel L Jackson and Margot Robbie. Tarzan, now living in England as Lord Greystoke, returns to the Congo to investigate a slave trader.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Christmas Laughs
programme.desc: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas! From Nativity! to Office Christmas Party, get into the festive spirit with this week's Christmas laughs Cinema List

programme.title: Demolition Man
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Sylvester Stallone, Wesley Snipes and Sandra Bullock. After failing to defuse a situation where villainous Simon Phoenix has taken 30 people hostage, Los Angeles Police sergeant John Spartan, known as the "Demolition Man", stands jointly accused of their manslaughter and the pair are imprisoned and frozen in a cryo penitentiary. When Phoenix escapes several decades later, Spartan is woken and sent to apprehend his old enemy in the futuristic city of San Angeles.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: Enter the Dragon
programme.desc: Classic martial arts adventure starring Bruce Lee. A master of martial arts is enlisted by British intelligence to help put an end to the traffic in opium and sex workers organised from an island fortress by a criminal mastermind.

programme.title: Snakes on a Plane
programme.desc: Action horror thriller starring Samuel L Jackson and Julianna Margulies. Grizzled FBI agent Neville Flynn is accompanying Mob murder witness Sean Jones on a flight from from Hawaii to Los Angeles, where Jones is due to testify against brutal crime boss Eddie Kim. But the aircraft holds a concealed cargo of lethal, aggressive reptiles.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Paul Walker and Vin Diesel. When illegal street racer Dominic Toretto is suspected of being the mastermind behind a series of truck hijacks, undercover police officer Brian O'Conner is sent to infiltrate his gang. But O'Conner's judgement becomes clouded when he falls in love with Toretto's sister, Mia.

programme.title: Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham and Idris Elba. Bickering agents Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw are paired up to track down a deadly supervirus that has been stolen by terrorist Brixton Lore. But Lore is no ordinary villain - he has been implanted with cybernetic technology that gives him superhuman strength.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Enter the Dragon
programme.desc: Classic martial arts adventure starring Bruce Lee. A master of martial arts is enlisted by British intelligence to help put an end to the traffic in opium and sex workers organised from an island fortress by a criminal mastermind.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Sports drama starring Tom Cruise, Robert Duvall and Nicole Kidman. Cocky racing driver Cole Trickle is revved up to take the stock-car circuit by storm, but his aggressive driving style soon lands him in hospital. There he meets Dr Claire Lewicki, who gives the young driver more than racing to think about.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Tommy Lee Jones and Will Smith. When a New York police officer is recruited by a top-secret agency that monitors alien activity he finds himself in a race against time to save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson. Having graduated from college, the Bellas reunite for one last harmonised hurrah in the form of an overseas tour.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
programme.desc: Comedy starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen. Nascar racing champion Ricky Bobby has all the trappings of a successful career: a glamorous wife, a luxury home and a fanatical fan base. But when French driver Jean Girard threatens Ricky's dominance, he seems ill-equipped to meet the challenge.

New girl Beca doesn't care about being popular on campus, but her singing voice makes her the centre of attention when she signs up to become part of the college's all-female a cappella group, the Barden Bellas. Determined to outshine them are their male counterparts, the Treblemakers.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2

programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead

Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: Stan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan and Gran find a mysterious old carved piece of wood while they're beachcombing. Is it from the wreck of Porthole Pete or a carving of a mermaid?

programme.title: Losgannan/Froglets
programme.desc:
Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a' dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich.
Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Feumaidh an Dùd Beag a bhith far an urrainn dha bhith dùdach fad' an là. Gu mì-fhortanach, chaidh e air seachran ach fhuair e a shlighe dhachaidh gu Planaid nan Dùd, le beagan taic bho a charaidean ùra
Little Dùd needs to be where he can hoot all day. Unfortunately, he goes missing but finds his way back home to Planet Dùd, with a little help from his new friends.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Tha dùbhradh grèine ann an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, tha a' Chearc Iarainn a' dùbhradh an dùbhradh. Ciamar a gheibh iad air seo a rèiteachadh?
There's a solar eclipse happening today but, unfortunately, the Iron Chicken is eclipsing the event. How will they resolve this?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Petit invites his friends to his father's workplace. However, his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how a carpentry can be lots of fun

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Gilleasbaig Ferguson reads Fear Coimhid nan Sgòthan written and illustrated by Tom McLaughlin and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart

programme.title: Belle agus Sebastian
programme.desc: Part two. Sebastian tells the second part of the story, recalling how he and Belle got close, as a result of him protecting her from the people of the village

programme.title: Belle agus Sebastian
programme.desc: When there's a school presentation to work on in the holidays, about regional animals during winter, Cameron wants the highest marks in the class - so cheats

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc: The Farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. The slock realise they will lose their beloved dump, so need to come up with an imaginative solution to save it

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: The CBBC ALBA team delve into the paranormal with some of the strangest phenomena in Scottish folklore, including the will-o-the-wisp, wailing women and changelings

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Flix is eager to hang out and help out at the Tiger Milk Café, when Munchkin's parents leave him in charge for a few hours

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: A journey throughout Scotland to discover the history and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan producers of woven fabrics

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh, agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Greim-Bidh le Gregor
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod meets the people and visits the places that provide the finest local produce. He begins on the Isle of Lewis where a local fisherman gives him fresh langoustines for an enormous, vibrant paella. He also visits a local honesty shed to pick up home-made raspberry jam to use in the most comforting way - jam roly-poly. Gregor also shares his recipe for fruit and nut crackers he likes to have alongside a selection of his favourite cheeses

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Half a century after the end of the Vietnam War and the country's reunification, Ramsay MacMahon embarks on a journey to discover how war and division continue to affect people in Vietnam today. During his journey, Ramsay meets former soldiers from both sides who come face to face with each other for the first time since the war ended. He joins teams working to clear unexploded ordnance from the ground; and he hears the stories of people still living with the consequences of chemical warfare

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: A performance by Mairi MacInnes and band at the 2025 Trad Awards, recorded live in Aberdeen. Songs include Mi 'm Shuidhe Nam Ònar and Kin (Càirdeas)

programme.title: Dana - Europe's Wild Side
programme.desc: Situated within the Arctic Circle, Norway's Lofoten islands offer a lifetime's worth of exploration in the outdoors. Attracted by the world-class climbing and surfing on offer, Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb, to glean once-in-a-lifetime experiences

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Kinga finally holds her triplets together, while Emily undergoes further tests. Diane faces a risk to her sight, Treasa and Ian receive devastating news, and Tom Óg reaches a key milestone

programme.title: Faodail: Beatha nan Eilean
programme.desc: Short films shot in the Outer Hebrides from the 1930s to the 1980s

programme.title: An Clò Mòr
programme.desc: The locals organise a ceilidh for Old Mary who is recovering from her mill accident. A drunken Boyd confronts Mairead and Cairistiona. Things turn sour between Johan and Murdina resulting in a mysterious fire starting at the hotel

programme.title: The Mauritanian
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Tahar Rahim and Jodie Foster. In the mid 2000s, US lawyer Nancy Hollander becomes involved in the defence of Mohamedou Ould Slahi, who is being detained in Guantánamo Bay under suspicion of participating in the 9/11 terrorist attacks. Though Hollander initially doubts Slahi's claims of innocence, the evidence in his favour mounts and a series of shocking truths are uncovered.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The penultimate leg through Australia sees a decisive Jeff and Matt risk an inland route to save funds for the final push, only to find themselves stranded in a remote town with no obvious connections. Princess and Junior choose to travel down the coast, but with their budget critically low they need to work as much as possible to make it to the final stage. Ella and Nana head to the shores of the largest sand island in the world, where Ella reflects on her recent heartbreak, and Sam and Kaz make a blunder that causes them precious time

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti are joined by South African chef Ash Valenzuela-Heeger, winner of the 2025 Michelin Young Chef Award, who sets the contestants the challenge of making barbecue beef sirloin, served with maitake mushrooms, caramelised roscoff onions and a cafe au lait sauce. The hopefuls then demonstrate their pastry knowledge as they serve up dessert

programme.title: MOTD: UEFA Champions League
programme.desc: Action from the matchday five fixtures, including Club Brugge v Liverpool at Jan Breydel Stadium, Sporting Lisbon v Manchester United at Estádio José Alvalade and Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund at Emirates Stadium. Liverpool were looking to bounce back from a shock defeat at the hands of Fenerbahce in matchday four, while United will have wanted to build on a comeback against AS Roma, and Arsenal aimed to maintain their unbeaten record in this season's competition

programme.title: The Mauritanian
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Tahar Rahim and Jodie Foster. In the mid 2000s, US lawyer Nancy Hollander becomes involved in the defence of Mohamedou Ould Slahi, who is being detained in Guantánamo Bay under suspicion of participating in the 9/11 terrorist attacks. Though Hollander initially doubts Slahi's claims of innocence, the evidence in his favour mounts and a series of shocking truths are uncovered.

programme.title: The Mauritanian
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Tahar Rahim and Jodie Foster. Though Hollander initially doubts Slahi's claims of innocence, the evidence in his favour mounts and a series of shocking truths are uncovered.

programme.title: Sound of Metal
programme.desc: Drama starring Riz Ahmed and Olivia Cooke. Ruben, the drummer in a heavy metal band, begins to experience hearing loss and is told his condition will deteriorate over time. Unable to afford treatment and unwilling to stop playing, Ruben lashes out, driving a wedge between him and his bandmate girlfriend, Lou. Could a community of deaf recovering substance addicts offer a lifeline?

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: The third week of heats gets under way as six more chefs enter the kitchen. Marcus Wareing challenges them to spatchcock and cook a quail, served with a complex marsala sauce and a cabbage garnish. For the signature dish round, they have just 90 minutes to put their own stamp on a plate and deliver a dish that makes the judges sit up and take notice

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
programme.desc: The historian uncovers the untold stories of incredible palaces and the people who lived there, beginning by travelling to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: It's bring-your-dog-to-work day for Martin Roberts in Cornwall. Martel Maxwell is in St Helens, where a damp terrace needs bringing back to life, and London's calling for Jacqui Joseph at a trainspotter's paradise

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz, which sees contestants Laura, Olu, Jack, Jane and Luke race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti are joined by Adejoké Bakare, the first black woman in the UK to be awarded a Michelin star, who sets the contestants the challenge of recreating a dish from her repertoire - mushroom moin moin served with a shito sauce and steamed egg. The hopefuls then demonstrate their pastry knowledge as they serve up dessert

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Susan, Chris, Anthony and Mark compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman search for tips and treats from food producers during a visit to Leicester Market, including a masterclasses in fajitas and gelato. Ryan Hand discovers why some snacks in the shops seem to be shrinking, Michaela Chiappa reveals what makes a perfect coffee and chef Julie Lin is on a mission to discover the story behind Scotland's square sausages

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the wild and rugged coastline of Northumberland by rail, beginning in Morpeth, where he finds an historic collection of Northumbrian bagpipes and discovers how difficult they are to play. The East Coast mainline delivers Michael to Widdrington and its long sandy bay, where a beachcombing blacksmith finds treasures to inspire artwork in steel

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: Liz heads to Belize as she explores the Central American coastline, which supports an extraordinary array of wildlife and is home to some of the world's most endangered animals. With a scientist in Cockscomb Reserve, Liz goes on the trail of a jaguar that's suspected of taking local pigs, and helps a small Mayan village ward off future attacks. Travelling on to Costa Rica, Liz meets a man who turned his father's farm into a haven for frogs that is now home to 29 species - from the blue jean strawberry dart frog to the red-eyed tree frog and ghost frog

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The team returns for a second stint in the cloisters of Norwich Cathedral. Items presented for scrutiny include original illustrations to children's novel Black Beauty, fragments of porcelain that recall the tragedy in Hiroshima, and a rare saucer used for years as an ashtray - valued at £1,000

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team heads to Stockport Town Hall in Greater Manchester, where Philip Serrell examines a collection of evocative war diaries and Mark Stacey falls for a mosaic necklace and earring set. Paul Martin takes time out to explore the history behind the town's air-raid shelters

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor presents news from inside the training rooms as the celebrities prepare for their week 10 dances. Also, the week's Pro Panel break down all the Blackpool performances

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul travel to Co Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Researchers estimate another billion people will be online within the next five years, with the majority of these newcomers will be from developing nations in southern Asia and Africa. Hannah Fry learns about what this influx of web users will mean for the future of the internet and what will it mean for the rest of the world

programme.title: Rollercoaster: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programme.desc: Hannah Fry gets the inside story on the UK's newest, tallest and fastest rollercoaster, Thorpe Park's Hyperia, as she uncovers the origins of the modern-day thrill ride. She finds out how dodgy French physics from the 19th century, Nasa rocket scientists and an ambitious cartoonist called Walt delivered the ultimate ride

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Painting conservator Lucia Scalisi revives a remarkable but badly bent and buckled portrait of Captain William Marshall, who risked his life to rescue over a hundred shipwrecked Irish emigrants left stranded on an iceberg. Brenton West repairs a precious boxing trophy from the 1950s, Will Kirk restores a well-travelled Jamaican trunk - with help from bookbinder Chris Shaw and textiles conservator Rebecca Bissonet - and Kirsten Ramsay faces the ultimate 3D jigsaw as she is handed a plaster bust that shattered to pieces in an accident

programme.title: Murder Case: Fire in the Suburbs
programme.desc: Part two of two. Bex Williams wakes up from her coma and reveals crucial information about the night of the arson attack, but cannot identify who the masked intruder was. With the killer still at large, detectives must look elsewhere for answers and their attention turns to Cameron Logan's older brother Blair, discovering the two had not always seen eye to eye

programme.title: The Son
programme.desc: Drama starring Hugh Jackman. Peter Miller, a successful businessman, reluctantly agrees to reconnect with the teenage son from his first marriage, who now suffers from severe depression. Having been estranged from one another, the two struggle to reconcile as Peter is forced, gradually, to reckon with his own shortcomings as a parent.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Science-fiction action adventure starring Rosa Salazar and Christoph Waltz. On a future Earth, Dr Dyson Ido reawakens a dormant cyborg and names her "Alita". With no memory of her past, Alita determines to find out what she can, while exploring the dark depths of Iron City. But when she's targeted by a vicious band of cyborg serial killers, Alita discovers she is a formidable fighter, a revelation that tips her into a dangerous new world.

programme.title: Criss Cross
programme.desc: Film noir starring Burt Lancaster. Honest armoured car guard Steve Thompson is drawn into a complicated robbery plan after being caught with his ex-wife by her new gangster husband.

programme.title: The Lady Eve
programme.desc: Classic screwball comedy starring Barbara Stanwyck and Henry Fonda.Working the cruise liners, beautiful trickster Jean Harrington believes that the highly eligible Charles Pike is there for the taking. If she plays her cards right.

programme.title: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: A former sheriff and a gambler are attacked by hostile Indians while trying to help a woman rescue her husband from a mine. Western, starring Susan Hayward, Gary Cooper and Richard Widmark

programme.title: Hell and High Water
programme.desc: Action spy drama starring Richard Widmark. A scientist who's concerned about the US government's preparedness for nuclear war hires a submarine captain to lead a search for communist weaponry in the north Pacific.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg. Bartender and petty thief Nathan Drake is recruited by veteran explorer Victor Sullivan for a globe-trotting mission to recover treasure supposedly buried by Ferdinand Magellan 500 years ago.

programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell. Over-achieving architect Doug Kinney struggles to divide his time between work and the demands of his family. The answer seems to come when he meets a scientist who has developed a way of making "perfect" clones. Doug hopes to solve his problems by being in two places at once - but will he be able to stop at two?

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jessica Chastain, Diane Kruger, Penélope Cruz and Lupita Nyong'o. CIA operative "Mace" Browne teams up with fellow agents from around the world in order to track down and recover a flash drive that has the potential, in the wrong hands, to destabilise the global political order.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick Stein travels to St Ives to meet one of Britain's little-known artists, Alfred Wallis. In the shadow of Bodmin Moor, Rick visits a very rare collection of medieval stained-glass windows in the church of St Neot. It is here he ticks off an item on his bucket list by taking part in a rather unusual celebration called Oak Apple Day, marking the occasion when Charles II became king.
And on the Cornish border with Devon, Rick meets a lamb farmer who is on a mission to rear the best lamb in the county, inspiring Rick to cook a delicious lamb stew called a Navarin.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick meets Springwatch presenter Gillian Burke, who takes Rick on a walk through a rare habitat called an Atlantic temperate rainforest on the banks of the Helford River

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Cornwall has more than its fair share of folktales. Perhaps the most famous is found near Land's End, where Rick recounts the tale of the Mermaid of Zennor. A short distance away, he joins a small army of seaweed harvesters who are feeding an increasing appetite for a natural food more common in Japan

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick roams the dramatic north Cornish coast to tell the story of one of Britain's best-loved writers, Thomas Hardy, and his little-known love affair with a Cornishwoman. Another famous writer, Dylan Thomas, once dubbed Rick's next stop, Mousehole, as 'the loveliest village in Britain'. It's here that Rick discovers the origins of the iconic Cornish dish stargazy pie

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Best of British
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers celebrate Britain's love of seafood and the plentiful and diverse supply of produce obtained from local waters. They also explore the history of Billingsgate Market in east London, the country's largest inland fish market

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson does his bit for the environment when he test drives the Toyota Prius, a hybrid car powered by petrol and electricity. The Who frontman Roger Daltrey is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The motorbike racer takes part in four more speed-based challenges and gets his hands dirty in unique engineering projects to discover what makes things go fast. In the first programme, he finds out how far it's possible to travel on a bicycle during 24 hours of non-stop pedalling. With the help of bike experts Miles Kingsbury and Mike Burrows he builds a tandem, and pairs up with his friend, endurance expert Jason Miles, to see how far they can push their bodies. In the build-up to the final record attempt at the historic Goodwood Motor Circuit, Guy also learns about the science of cooking for athletes with nutritionist Nigel Mitchell, who instructs him to lose five kilos and recommends a new diet regimen

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick Stein travels to St Ives to meet one of Britain's little-known artists, Alfred Wallis. In the shadow of Bodmin Moor, Rick visits a very rare collection of medieval stained-glass windows in the church of St Neot. It is here he ticks off an item on his bucket list by taking part in a rather unusual celebration called Oak Apple Day, marking the occasion when Charles II became king.
And on the Cornish border with Devon, Rick meets a lamb farmer who is on a mission to rear the best lamb in the county, inspiring Rick to cook a delicious lamb stew called a Navarin.

programme.title: The Body in the Bag
programme.desc: The case of Gareth Williams, a GCHQ employee on secondment to MI6, who was found dead inside a padlocked duffel bag in the bath of his London flat in 2010. The case has become one of the biggest unsolved mysteries in recent British history, and even now, 12 years after Williams' death, the public are still waiting for answers as to what happened to the 31-year-old codebreaker. Through interviews with former detectives, forensic investigators, MPs and people who knew Gareth, along with archive footage and reconstruction, this documentary re-examines the case in a bid to get to the bottom of the events that lead to Williams' untimely death - asking did he act alone or were other forces involved?

programme.title: DIY SOS: Million Pound Build for Children in Need
programme.desc: As part of the 2013 appeal, Nick Knowles and the team head to Peterborough to help Children in Need-funded organisation Little Miracles, which supports youngsters with disabilities and life-limiting illnesses and their families. However, whereas Mark, Chris, Julian and Billy normally renovate an existing property, for the first time they are knocking down a building and reconstructing it from the ground up - making it worth almost £1million. With just nine days to complete the job, they'll need help - and lots of it. Luckily, tradespeople turn out in force - from both the local area and across the country - giving their time for free

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: In the summer of 2015, West Sussex wife and mother-of-four Amanda fell off her bike while training for an endurance contest, breaking 11 bones, puncturing a lung, and snapping her collarbone and back. Paralysed, she spent the next six months at Stoke Mandeville's spinal unit, while her builder husband Vic looked after the children - but determined to compete again, she returned home in a wheelchair. However, the family home is no longer suitable for Amanda - so that's where Nick Knowles and the rest of the DIY SOS team come in, strengthened by a number of local tradesmen

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: DIY SOS: Million Pound Build for Children in Need
programme.desc: As part of the 2013 appeal, Nick Knowles and the team head to Peterborough to help Children in Need-funded organisation Little Miracles, which supports youngsters with disabilities and life-limiting illnesses and their families. However, whereas Mark, Chris, Julian and Billy normally renovate an existing property, for the first time they are knocking down a building and reconstructing it from the ground up - making it worth almost £1million. With just nine days to complete the job, they'll need help - and lots of it. Luckily, tradespeople turn out in force - from both the local area and across the country - giving their time for free

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: In the summer of 2015, West Sussex wife and mother-of-four Amanda fell off her bike while training for an endurance contest, breaking 11 bones, puncturing a lung, and snapping her collarbone and back. Paralysed, she spent the next six months at Stoke Mandeville's spinal unit, while her builder husband Vic looked after the children - but determined to compete again, she returned home in a wheelchair. However, the family home is no longer suitable for Amanda - so that's where Nick Knowles and the rest of the DIY SOS team come in, strengthened by a number of local tradesmen

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: Paramedics treat a woman trapped in her car after a crash, a man with a hernia and a sick 3-year-old. Plus, they're called to an elderly woman who has badly cut her legs.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: The blue lights are flashing as crews attend a cycling accident and a man having a suspected stroke. The paramedics assist a woman who has fallen and a baby with multiple seizures.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: Call handlers answer a 999 call from a distressed mother whose baby has accidentally poured boiling tea over himself. Paramedic Andy is called out to an 86-year-old woman trapped beneath a car, and his colleague Lydia helps a 35-year-old man who is feeling suicidal. A fast-response car is dispatched when a three-year-old is hit by a vehicle, and Andy joins the police when a 13-year-old is stabbed on the way home from school

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Nothing screams 1970s more than a Mk3 Ford Cortina 2000E. Derek Mathewson heads to Brigg to value a 1974 example with classic Coke bottle styling and a Pinto engine.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek's got his work cut out collecting a huge haul that includes two Bentleys, a Daimler and a traditional Bowtop caravan.

programme.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programme.desc: The boys visit Norfolk to assist retired engineer Graham and his wife Lindsay. They discover a rare tandem disability scooter, along with a retro record player in need of TLC.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores East Anglia between the wars, beginning at Sutton Hoo in Suffolk, where archaeologists discovered a 27-metre-long Anglo-Saxon ship in 1939. In the Essex village of Dedham, he unearths a nasty brush between painters, with art experts explaining the antipathy between traditional artist Alfred Munnings and the modern art school established in the village by Cedric Morris

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits several of London's most famous locations, beginning on the South Bank, where the 1951 Festival of Britain drew more than eight and a half million visitors to admire fantastical buildings designed to inspire and celebrate the best of British in art, science and industry. After a spin on the London Eye, built to celebrate the millennium, Michael takes the London Underground to Chelsea to find out about Elizabeth David, one of the most influential cookery writers of the 20th century, and also heads to Covent Garden and Regent's Park

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his Bradshaw's-inspired journey through East Anglia, where he discovers the Essex origins of the BBC. He also joins the Women's Land Army to pick damsons at Tiptree and visits homes fit for heroes in Becontree

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures deep underground onto London's newest railway - the Elizabeth Line - enjoying a smooth ride from Paddington to Tottenham Court Road. Emerging into the sunshine in Bedford Square, Michael recalls the choking smogs which plagued the capital during the 1950s. He learns how smoke-free zones were introduced to tackle the problem and, high above the capital at the top of the BT Tower, discovers how the capital's air quality is monitored today

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Yosemite National Park in California, beholding its towering granite cliffs, giant sequoia trees and cascading waterfalls. He then heads to the University of California's seismology department to hear about the devastating 1906 San Francisco earthquake, which claimed the lives of approximately 3,000 people and destroyed more than 80 per cent of the city

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Dave has to extricate a VW Golf from a garden that has grown up around it.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: Bangers & Cash spin-off series that follows the journey of a vehicle purchased at a Mathewsons classic car auction, before being repaired, restored and re-auctioned.

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier narrates the story of the D-Day landings in June 1944, when the Allies launched the biggest ever amphibious invasion on the beaches of Normandy. Although both sides suffered heavy casualties, it proved to be the turning point in the war against Germany

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: A look at the early stages of genocide at the camp, examining the role of commander Rudolf Hoess in the process. Despite later claiming he was only following orders, Hoess was instrumental in the development of Auschwitz for mass murder, arranging for Soviet prisoners to be brought in as construction workers and scouring Europe for more victims to kill. Featuring contributions from survivors

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The programme returns to the waterfront beside the V&A Dundee design museum, with Fiona Bruce going aboard the Discovery to reveal the epic story of the ship and Antarctic explorer Robert Falcon Scott. Items brought in to be assessed by the experts include a self-pouring teapot, a glass helmet and a piece of tartan that has been to the Moon

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents from the National Botanic Garden of Wales in Carmarthenshire, exploring the Victorian mania for collecting exotic plants and examining rare species grown inside the gigantic bio-dome. The team assesses items brought in by the public, with Duncan Campbell inspecting a Chinese box that Hollywood star Gregory Peck tried - and failed - to buy, and John Axford is amazed to see an extremely rare 12th-century bronze statuette brought back from Calcutta in the 1920s

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Dave goes to Wales to bag a Sierra Cosworth, a sought-after car in the bidding market. Dad Derek gets his hands on a more sedate 1926 Standard Tourer.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek heads to Suffolk to collect two Bentleys with a majestic pedigree; Cynthia a stunning 1963 S3 and Harry, a 1965 Continental.

programme.title: Incredible Journeys with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: A look at the challenge of preserving unspoilt wildernesses, from the icy expanses of Siberia to the tropical forests of central and South America. Simon reflects on how his past series have dealt with the causes and impact of climate change, as well as remembering a memorable report exposing the extent of plastic pollution in the ocean. He also recalls meeting indigenous people around the world and hearing their first-hand experiences of ecological damage

programme.title: This World: Cuba with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Two years after Cuba announced radical economic reforms, broadcaster Simon Reeve heads to the Caribbean island to look at the effects the liberalisation has had. He meets Cubans whose lives are being transformed - from the owners of fledgling businesses to the newly rich estate agents selling properties valued at up to £750,000 - and asks if this new openness could lead to more political freedom. He also explores whether Cuba will be able to maintain the positive aspects of its long isolation under socialism - such as low crime, high-quality education and one of the best healthcare systems in the world - while embracing a form of capitalism. Part of the This World strand

programme.desc: Guy joins a multi-generational family business who rescue crashed or broken-down HGVs as he learns the physics of truck recovery and operates a crane during a complex rescue.

Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.

Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.title: Escape to Victory

As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale

In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.desc: Sci-fi action drama starring Sharlto Copley. Nearly thirty years after aliens landed near Johannesburg, the extraterrestrial visitors are living in a squalid refugee camp called District 9. With the initial welcoming attitude of the human population long since faded, the order is given for the space visitors to be forcibly evicted. For one man, the operation will be a life-changing experience.

programme.title: Event Horizon

When scientists Ira Kane and Harry Block find a crashed meteorite in the Arizona desert, they are able to extract a slimy blue fluid from it. But the bizarre substance contains alien organisms that are capable of evolving at an unprecedented rate, and this has consequences for the survival of Earth itself.

programme.title: Live NFL
programme.desc: Detroit Lions v Chicago Bears (Kick-off 6.00pm). Coverage of the week 12 match from Ford Field. The Lions have played a home game on Thanksgiving Day almost every year since 1934, with the only exceptions being six years during World War II. The tradition began when then-owner George A. Richards wanted to build excitement and draw attention ahead of a match against the unbeaten Chicago Bears, and it proved to be so successful it was broadcast by 94 radio stations across the country, becoming the first-ever national NFL radio broadcast

programme.title: Live NFL
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys v Philadelphia Eagles (Kick-off 9.30pm). Coverage of the week 12 match from AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. The Cowboys first played a Thanksgiving Day fixture in 1966 and have done so every year since then, except for 1975 and 1977. They come into this year's match having won in each of the last three years, including a 31-28 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs 12 months ago

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc:
Steve travels to the deadliest desert on the planet, the Baja peninsula in Mexico, where he goes searching for a gruesome savage killer in the form of a tarantula hawk wasp. This predator lays an egg in its tarantula prey, which hatches into a maggot, which then eats the spider from the inside - while it's still alive! It is the biggest wasp in the world and has a paralysing sting which makes even Steve nervous - that doesn't stop him handling it though.
The desert of Baja, Mexico, is serpent central and Steve has the time of his life catching snakes. These include a cape water snake, and a coachwhip snake that catches Steve unaware and lands a cheeky bite on his hand. He then embarks on a regular rattlesnake round-up, clocking up encounters with the venomous red diamond and Baja rattlesnakes before an encounter with a speckled rattlesnake tops off the best snake-hunting day Steve has ever had in his life.
Steve also takes to water in the Sea of Cortez in search of a monster of the deep seas. Known locally as the Red Devil, legend talks of its ability to snatch fishermen from their boats before tearing them to shreds - it is the Humboldt squid. Snatching fishermen is probably a little far-fetched, but Steve takes no chances and wears chain mail to protect him from the squid's razor-sharp beak and its 16 thousand sucker cup teeth.
Incidental finds which don't make it onto Steve's list are a mole lizard which looks like one of the oddest creatures on the planet and a torchlit walk in the local vicinity which reveals he and his crew are literally surround by scorpions.

Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Reau, Alfie, Charlie, Ollie, Otis, River and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too!
Inside Giovanna's bag is a night light, and all the parents and babies have different objects and toys that could be used as part of a bedtime routine. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story.

We follow Caleb and his family as they learn about and celebrate the American festival of Thanksgiving.
Caleb and his family play American football in the garden, and then Captain Caleb goes out on a yacht to experience what being out at sea would have been like. He also visits an old ship to learn what life on board was like. Caleb, mum and dad go to a free range turkey farm, where they get up close to the prehistoric looking birds! They also learn all about how to care for them.
Next, Caleb and his family visit a pumpkin patch to pick pumpkins for Thanksgiving. Back at home, they decorate the house to get ready for the celebration. Before they sit down to eat their Thanksgiving meal, they pull on their fancy dress for a fun Thanksgiving day parade with their neighbours. Join Caleb as he celebrates Thanksgiving!

Tinks and Charli are planting some seeds at the allotments. Tinks chats to her gardening friends the gnomes and braves the big dark shed to find Charli's gardening gloves, before choosing some sunflower seeds and helping Charli to plant them. But when Charli sends Tinks on a mission to find the watering can, it turns out to be empty. The allotments are a big place for a little dog. Next, they meet some naked mole rats. These incredible looking creatures live underground, and the team have to use special night vision cameras to see them. The mole rats have huge teeth, no hair and spend much of their time walking backwards. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.desc: BBC Alba joins Radio nan Gàidheal, the BBC's Gaelic language radio service

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Bing agus a charaidean a' tarraing dealbh do Gilly, tha Teàrlaidh a' cur sgròb mhòr air feadh an deilbh aige-san ach tha Gilly a sealltainn dhaibh nach b' e droch rud a bh' ann.
When Bing and his friends draw a picture for Gilly, Charlie does a squiggle on Bing's picture. But Gilly shows them that this is not such a bad thing.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Bing aig taigh Sula 'son Pàrtaidh Aodach-oichdh', tha e a' gabhail feagal nuair a tha e a' cluinntinn meanglan mòr, sgrìobach bho muigh. Ach, an uairsin, tha e ag ionnsachadh nach eil rudan eagallach cho eagallach sa shaoileas tu.
When Bing is at Sula's house for a PJ Party, he gets frightened when he hears a large scratchy branch outside. At the end of the day though, he learns that things aren't as scary as you think they are.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc:
Tha Hari air mìlsean bhlasta a bhèiceadh airson Ela agus Seren - cèic teòclaid! Bidh aon Abadas air a thaghadh airson a dhol a shealltainn airson rudeigin eile cruinn agus milis. Dè bhios ann?
Hari has prepared a yummy treat for Ela and Seren - a chocolate cake! One Abadas will be chosen to go on another exciting adventure looking for something round and sweet-smelling. What could it be?

programme.title: Cleasan Àtaidh & Tilidh (The Adventures of Abney & Teal)
programme.desc: Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own, but gets stuck in it and needs help from Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs

programme.title: 'S E Iasg a Th'Annam (I'm a Fish)
programme.desc: The Tuna Fish tells us how speedy they are and how they are good hunters. They hunt with their friends, the dolphins, as the dolphins keep them safe from other predators

programme.title: Òrain CBeebies
programme.desc: A selection of seafaring songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Iain MacInnes reads Am Pàrtaidh Teatha aig Dadaidh by Mike Sperring, illustrated by Sarah Warburton and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: The Ugly Pageant is staged, where participants decide who the ugliest Bògais is

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: When Bonns is out finding food for his 12-course midnight snack, the Cnuimhean catch and kidnap him

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc: The Farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. The slock realise they will lose their beloved dump, so need to come up with an imaginative solution to save it

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: The little girl tries to resolve Daibhidh’s nightmares. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street and her presence is not helping

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: The lads go out of their comfort zone and go plant-based. Uisdean starts off by preparing Seitan, a meat substitute made from wheat gluten. Ruaridh recreates a recipe he often cooks at home, having realised that his Moroccan chickpea stew is fully plant-based. He accompanies it with an excellent vegan flatbread. A bean burger is Uisdean's main dish, while Ruaridh makes vegan sausage rolls with home-made beans in tomato sauce. When the seitan has cooked and cooled down, Uisdean slices it up and makes an alternative to spicy chicken wings. The dish is accompanied by a sticky spicy sauce

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the first steps of speaking Gaelic, joined by studio guest Iain MacPherson who hails from Alberta, Canada. Plus, Calum Maclean visits a thriving community project in Glasgow

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: In the village of Appin, Gregor MacCormick shows his collection of vintage engines, and retired sea Captain Eric Smith visits the new lighthouse ship, the Pole Star

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Daisy receives emergency treatment for severe breathing problems, while Treasa and Ian welcome their twins and prepare to lose Joshua. Diane makes progress, and Méabh is transferred closer to home

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Zac, who has never settled into responsible adult life, receives an opportunity for pop stardom

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
Tha Bagelean Abigail fìor bhlast' agus sònraicht' 'son bruinse no lòn, no fiù 's aig àm sam bith, 's 'ad gad shàsachadh ann an dòigh nach gabh inns' 's iad fèìr taght' 'son an roinn leis an teaghlach no le caraidean.
Abigail's bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Spoof documentary. Angela clashes with angry locals shouting about short-term lets. There's a sticky situation when an activist sneaks through the catflap with a tube of superglue

programme.title: An t-Uisge (Rain Stories)
programme.desc: Anne Lundon visits one of Scotland's newest island distilleries to find out the connection between rainwater and the national drink, and learns of a frog wedding in India

programme.title: Dana - Europe's Wild Side
programme.desc: Situated within the Arctic Circle, Norway's Lofoten islands offer a lifetime's worth of exploration in the outdoors. Attracted by the world-class climbing and surfing on offer, Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb, to glean once-in-a-lifetime experiences

programme.title: Michael McIntyre's The Wheel
programme.desc: The comedian hosts the game show in which contestants answer questions with the aid of celebrity experts, aware that one wrong answer means someone else gets a chance. The celebrity experts are Italian Bach, Kerry Godliman, Trevor Nelson, Angela Scanlon, Alex Scott, Josh Widdicombe, Bez and Shaun Ryder

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: Documentary following the police, fire and ambulance services as they attend emergency situations in rural communities. The East Anglian Air Ambulance races to save a farmer after a freak accident, lambs face attack from birds of prey, and reporter Paul Colgan investigates illegal fly-tipping in Cheshire. Featuring accounts from first responders, community members and farmers at the centre of these emergencies

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: An 'uninhabitable' house in Clackmannanshire and a Lincolnshire layout disaster need lots of work, whereas a Leicester flat is pretty much good to go

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: At the Detling Showground in Kent, Stephanie Connell helps the reds tackle a military challenge, while John Cameron and the blues hunt for a music or drama-related item. The rivalry leads to plenty of friendly competition around the fair and dishes up some drama at the auction. Charlie Ross monitors progress and also visits nearby Lullingstone Castle, former site of the UK's first silk farm, to learn about some unusual former residents

programme.title: Celebrity Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Amanda Holden joins the team for a special episode for Scam Safe Week, in which she helps them go after the criminals who used her name and image to con victims out of thousands. Using the same remote access tech scammers rely on, the team will hack the hackers to monitor their operations in real time, before confronting the fraudsters, and stopping scams before they happen

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When Phil returns home to find someone hanging around his house, he decides to confront him and finds some incriminating evidence on his doorbell footage. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan takes a trip to a garden centre to highlight simple tips that can deter wannabe burglars. And Janet turns doorbell detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives

And Janet turns doorbell detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk.
