Former police inspector Anton Sullivan takes a trip to a garden centre to highlight simple tips that can deter wannabe burglars. And Janet turns doorbell detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

Former police inspector Anton Sullivan takes a trip to a garden centre to highlight simple tips that can deter wannabe burglars. And Janet turns doorbell detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

programme.title: George Best: All By Himself
programme.desc: Daniel Gordon's film charts the life of George Best, whose footballing skills gave him a celebrity that was the equal of the Beatles'. But despite his prodigious talent, Belfast-born Best struggled with inner demons that would ultimately undermine his career.

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: In the summer of 1989, Bill Rich moves with his pregnant partner Liz and teenage son Jonathan to a remote farmhouse in the idyllic Brecon Beacons. On the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, Liz and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams, and as strange events intensify, the family is forced to accept a terrifying new reality. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: The family receive a shockingly high electricity bill and their animals start to behave oddly. Liz attends a mother and baby group where she meets spiritualist Bethan, who offers to conduct a seance. After a strained Christmas dinner, Jonathan admits he's also seen a ghost, while Liz and Bill beg Brecon Council for help, raising the suspicions of social services

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk interrogates some of the world's foremost filmmakers and critics, discovers an age of screen icons from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, and learns how Hollywood movies changed as American social values relaxed. She also gives her verdict on classics like Jaws, Taxi Driver, and Citizen Ken - very much the 'Citizen Kane' of films about people called Ken. Comedy, starring Diane Morgan

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress learns about the art of patisserie in Paris, which is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world, sampling the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and a dahlia

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman is in Gloucestershire with Sam and Mandy, who are moving from a harbour town in Devon and making a fresh start in the countryside, with their two much-loved dogs coming along for the adventure. Nicki also gets an invitation to experience horticulture on a truly regal scale when she visits a garden quite literally fit for a king

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Philippa, Nathan, Pete, Natalie and Sandra race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals

programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Monty Don celebrates the rewards of winter gardening, sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding viewers that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there is always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Family members Sarah, Paul, Curtis and Jessica compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray and Edith Bowman discover tips and treats at the food and music festival in Newcastle. They find out how to create award-winning burgers and reveal the secrets of chips, French-Canadian style. Briony-May Williams goes on the trail of the nation's favourite herb and chef Julie Lin sets sail to find Scotland's most valuable fish. Farmer Meinir Howells investigates the growing popularity of keeping chickens

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels the length of the Northumbrian coastline, with its glorious beaches and grandiose castles. In the village of Alnmouth he takes to the waves in a traditional skiff built by members of the Alnmouth Coastal Rowing Club. His last stop of the day is the mighty Bamburgh Castle

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: Liz explores the volcanic islands of the Lesser Antilles, joining residents of Mayreau who are repairing their island's vibrant coral that has been damaged by disease. On neighbouring Union Island, Liz goes on patrol with an environmental army protecting the Union Island gecko, one of the smallest reptiles in the world and which was once one of the most trafficked reptiles in the Caribbean

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team make the show's first trip to Londonderry, where they value more objects brought in by the public. Among items displayed for their scrutiny are a set of intricate hand-cut pictures, a cushion woven from human hair and a collection of silver worth more than £100,000. First shown in 2006

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin, Will Axon and Philip Serrell visit Ickworth House, a Georgian mansion in Suffolk built for the Earls of Bristol, where the team picks out a selection of interesting items to be sold at auction. Will casts an appreciative eye over a piece of Martinware, but a miniature long case clock bought at the car boot for £1 could prove to be the star find. Paul also heads to the Suffolk coast to explore a fantasy holiday village built in the early 20th century

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen asks the questions as Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad face the penultimate round of challenges

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Costume designer Vicky Gill reveals what the couples will be wearing at the weekend, and Ellie Taylor has more backstage gossip

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Wanting a new start in Devon, a couple with a budget of £650,000 enlist Jules Hudson's house-hunting knowhow to find a detached family home with a large garden for their two young children and some income potential. While in the county, Jules gets stuck into some woodcraft using nothing but steam to sculpt some impressive interior design pieces

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: The presenter travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens, thanks to the warm and wet climate. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones

programme.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
programme.desc: On 24 September 2025, a massive sinkhole opened outside a Bangkok hospital, swallowing vehicles, damaging infrastructure and forcing nearly 1,000 people to evacuate. This film investigates its causes, exploring how collapsing tunnels, ageing sewers, abandoned mines, groundwater depletion and urban development contribute to the growing global threat of city sinkholes

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk heads to Hollywood, where she accosts some of the people behind the biggest movies of recent years, from The Avengers to Transformers. She takes a look at Star Wars, Jurassic Park, Toy Story, the home video revolution, the rise of the blockbuster franchise and the state of cinema today in the wake of the rise of artificial intelligence

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: Bert and Harry launch a high-speed chase along narrow country roads near Portadown in pursuit of a dangerous driver, while Tom's patience is tested by an abusive suspect in Belfast. Dave and Owen are on the beat dealing with the challenge of addiction and rough sleeping, and Dave tries to explain the complicated dynamic between police and people on the street. As their shift ends, they meet a woman whose story brings that dynamic into devastating focus

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Police race to a Skye hotel after a barman is violently assaulted, but the suspect has fled and officers must track him down. In Inverness, police prepare to raid a house suspected of links to a Liverpool drugs gang, while on the Western Isles, officers race to a reported home invasion in a remote village, only to discover that all is not as it seems

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill Murray, but with his brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together, but by the time they reach Cruit Island in Co Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry

programme.title: Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Metal expert Dominic Chinea and wood restorer Will Kirk have the rare opportunity to work on a wooden travel trunk, used by a family of Polish refugees as they travelled the globe looking for a permanent place to call home. They eventually voyaged to Britain aboard the Empire Windrush in 1948, with all their possessions kept in the trunk.
Gil and Sue Duffy from Worcestershire have a precious parcel for the attention of ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay. The glass and resin trophy was created in honour of their daughter Krissy, who died at just 31 years of age. She was a keen horsewoman and classic car racing driver. An unfortunate accident caused a large section of glass to snap off the trophy, the resin horse head to fall off and the wooden plinth to get scuffed. Will helps with the plinth and sets about crafting a bespoke travel case to keep the trophy safe, while Kirsten has the tricky task of gluing the substantial glass pieces together.
Clockwork guru and vintage toy enthusiast Steve Fletcher is captivated when Martin and Richard Scott, from Lincolnshire, arrive bearing a 1940s toy gyroscope complete with the original box. The little plastic cyclist should pedal his bike when a cord is pulled, but he stalled 70 years ago and hasn't got going since. His plastic limbs and body are disintegrating and both the front wheel and mechanism are broken. Steve comes up with an ingenious plan to get this plucky cyclist back on his bike and race ready.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick visits a Cornish dairy, and inspired by the cheese they produce, he decides to bake sumptuous cheese and chive scones. The salty old fishing town of Newlyn is Rick's next stop and the unlikely setting, perhaps, of one of Britain's most revolutionary art movements

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
Rick is in Falmouth, discovering that far from being 'that bit on the end of Britain', Cornwall used to be at the very heart of the British Empire's communication system and is still very much a working port today.
It was the seas around Cornwall that inspired author William Golding to write his famous novel Lord of the Flies, and his daughter Judy tells Rick how her father was horrified by what he witnessed during the war. And Rick gets to enjoy dishes prepared for him by an innovative young chef called Andy Tuck, who cooks everything over wood - forget your BBQ, this is cooking with fire on a whole new level.

programme.title: Great Canal Journeys
programme.desc: Timothy West and Prunella Scales venture into the open sea as they make their way through the islands of Scotland's coast. Their destination is the rarely used nine-mile Crinan canal on the Mull of Kintyre, described as the world's most beautiful shortcut. However, the Atlantic waves off the coast of Mull force them to head inland to Tobermory. They later explore the holy island of Iona and the Isle of Jura

programme.title: Top Gear

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: The inclusion of a letter in a late actor's biography reopens an old case for the team - but reliving the past threatens to be too much for the widow who was accidentally responsible for his death. DAC Strickland's cocky nephew lends his assistance, but his affections for Sandra bring out the worst in Gerry and Brian. Dexter Fletcher guest stars

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The award-winning documentary series reveals how the end of the Second World War resulted in Britain's military and economic exhaustion, leaving Europe at the mercy of sparring superpowers as the Cold War era dawned. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: Jeremy Isaacs' classic documentary explores the Second World War's powerful legacy. For many people the conflict was the most significant experience of their lives, but it also left millions dead - ordinary civilians and victims of persecution, as well as military casualties. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: Churchill's Bid to Abolish Britain
programme.desc: This ambitious, striking film tells an astonishing story which challenges our understanding of the Second World War and our perception of world-renowned leaders.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his railway journey from Newcastle to Loch Ness, steered by his 1930s Bradshaw's Guide. Stopping at Dundee, Michael heads for Glamis Castle, where Lady Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon, the Queen Mother, grew up. Michael hears about her happy childhood and how she later found sanctuary there, when King Edward VIII abdicated and she and Prince Albert unexpectedly became king and queen of the United Kingdom

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is at Elgin's port, the coastal town of Lossiemouth, where the Labour Party's first prime minister James Ramsay MacDonald was born. Nearby, Michael finds a remote boarding school established in the 1930s and famous today both for its unusual ideas and its royal former pupils. His penultimate stop is Inverness, where he uncovers the work of female photographer MEM Donaldson, who documented a Highland way of life that was rapidly disappearing. Michael's journey ends at Loch Ness, where he joins a Deep Scan research team scouring the deep for signs of the elusive monster

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the West Country between the wars, setting off from the Cornish seaside resort of St Ives and ending his first in the former mining village of St Day. He visits Britain's first studio pottery, where he attempts a decorative wax technique and feels the heat of the firing kiln. Michael also joins a family on holiday in a railway carriage called Harvey

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo visits Cornwall's county town, Truro, heading to the historic estate of Trewithen, whose gardens were stocked from China by professional plant hunters commissioned by its owner. The Atlantic Coast branch line carries Michael north to Newquay, where he discovers a pioneering surfer and braves the waves on a belly board. In the nearby village of St Mawgan, Michael is introduced to the ancient Cornish sport of 'wrassling', which surged in popularity between the wars as part of a Cornish Celtic revival

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches Bodmin en route to Totnes, as he explores the West Country from St Ives to Salisbury Plain. Out on the rugged moor, Michael hears how the celebrated author Daphne du Maurier captivated readers between the wars with her tales of smuggling at the Jamaica Inn. In Devon, Michael takes the plunge at Plymouth's beautiful art deco Tinside Lido, while at Ivybridge, he boards a vehicle like no other to cross the causeway to Burgh Island, where a 1930s playboy built a splendid art deco party palace

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's exploration of the West Country continues in south Devon. He arrives in Paignton to investigate an extraordinarily high murder rate in the literature of the 1930s. The Dartmouth Steam Railway conveys him in style to the beautiful home of Agatha Christie, in the company of her great-grandson, James Prichard

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo crosses the county line from Devon into Somerset, seeing first-hand how willow farmers sought to overcome the challenge from the production of synthetic plastics during the 1930s and hearing how tourism has spread across the region, especially amongst the young. In Bath, Michael visits the former home of a refugee emperor, whose country was invaded by the Italian dictator Mussolini, and in whose name a religious movement began that now flourishes worldwide. Travelling east into Wiltshire, he reaches the largest training area of the British Army, Salisbury Plain

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough looks at nature's most amazing animals. In this episode it is the giant squid and owls.

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: From pythons in Bangkok to otters in Singapore, this documenary explores the extraordinary ways wildlife is making itself at home in the world's cities

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: Animals that travel in and out of cities in search of food or a safe place for their young. African penguins have found the streets of Cape Town a safe environment from predators, while still providing easy access to their fishing grounds, while in St Lucia, hippos have developed a taste for eating residents' lawns. Black bears roam the streets of cities across North America, seeking out discarded food to help them consume the 20,000 calories a day they need to survive their six-month hibernation

programme.title: Wild Metropolis
programme.desc: Animals displaced from their habitats by human expansion, including elephants in Sri Lanka and capuchin monkeys on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica. The programme also examines situations where humans have learned to live alongside their animal neighbours, including a heron that has been visiting an Amsterdam house twice a day for 17 years and a project to preserve manatees in Florida that has saved them from being an endangered species

programme.title: Attenborough and the Mammoth Graveyard
programme.desc: David Attenborough joins a team of archaeologists and palaeontologists excavating a mammoth graveyard discovered by fossil hunters in the prehistoric riverbed of the Thames. The site has also led to the discovery of stone artefacts, providing an insight into the relationship between early humans and mammoths during the Ice Ages. Leading experts in the fields of evolution provide their insight into this unique vision of prehistoric Britain

programme.desc: Nick Knowles and team, together with West Bromwich volunteers, helps a grieving grandmother and her family who are making do in a small house. programme.title: DIY SOS: Grenfell
programme.desc: Part one of two. Nick Knowles and the team undertake their biggest and longest build yet, constructing two buildings for the Grenfell community over several months to create spaces worth around £2million. With the aid of large construction companies, generous suppliers, volunteers and the Duke of Cambridge - who visits the site - the team starts by building a new home for the Dale Youth Boxing Club. The club started the careers of James DeGale, who won an Olympic gold medal in Beijing in 2008, and George Groves, current WBA Super Middleweight champion, as well as other national champions

programme.title: DIY SOS: Grenfell
programme.desc: Part two of two. Nick Knowles and the team attempt to build a two storey flexible use centre, which can be used by the local community however it decides. programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his Bradshaw's-inspired journey through East Anglia, where he discovers the Essex origins of the BBC. He also joins the Women's Land Army to pick damsons at Tiptree and visits homes fit for heroes in Becontree

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures deep underground onto London's newest railway - the Elizabeth Line - enjoying a smooth ride from Paddington to Tottenham Court Road. Emerging into the sunshine in Bedford Square, Michael recalls the choking smogs which plagued the capital during the 1950s. He learns how smoke-free zones were introduced to tackle the problem and, high above the capital at the top of the BT Tower, discovers how the capital's air quality is monitored today

programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Bradshaw travels resume in leafy Hertfordshire, where he attempts a canoe slalom course at the Lee Valley White Water Centre, built for the London Olympics in 2012. Travelling north, the presenter reaches Hatfield and the country estate of the queen of romance and author of 723 books, Barbara Cartland. In Stevenage, Michael learns how, in 1935, a new enterprise boosted production of the nation's daily loaf with a factory in the town.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo begins the latest leg on the seafront at Felixstowe, where in January 1953 the town was engulfed in the worst flooding to hit England in the 20th century. In Norwich, he admires the Norman Cathedral, then traces the history of the postcode

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the port of Monterey, he discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage, before heading to Paso de Robles, where he tours Hearst Castle, dream home of the newspaper baron, William Randolph Hearst. In the hills of Morro Bay, Michael joins avocado farmer, Jim Shanley, amid his 4,000 avocado trees to harvest the pears and learn how to make guacamole. Arriving in Los Angeles, Michael heads for the Warner Brothers studio, founded on Sunset Boulevard

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek is off to Bridlington to pick up a trio of classics: a Morris 8 tourer, a Mini Van and a 1940s Morris LC3 truck.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
programme.desc: A super rare Reliant Scimitar GTC undergoes an expert recommission, leaving no bolt unturned. And a Honda CBR superbike from the 80s is in need of repair.

programme.title: The World at War
programme.desc: The Nazi occupation of Holland, which began relatively peacefully with Dutch civil servants continuing to run their own country, but eventually resulted in many thousands of deaths through the attempted elimination of Jewish citizens and starvation of the non-Jewish inhabitants. Narrated by Laurence Olivier

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Examining the complex system the Nazis set up to implement the extermination of the Jewish race throughout Europe from 1942, with Auschwitz as the hub. The programme reveals that at other camps, including Treblinka, Belzec and Sobibor, rival commanders participated in the genocide with enthusiasm and shared ideas for the best method of mass murder

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and the team return for a second visit to Morden Hall Park in South London, where items include letters written by Mother Teresa and a bronze by South African sculptor Anton Van Wouw. There is also a colourful collage by celebrated British artist and illustrator John Minton, and a huge collection of intricately designed silver vinaigrette boxes

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and the team return for a second visit to Lytham Hall in Lancashire, where items assessed include a chair believed to be from Nelson's flagship and a series of watercolours rescued from a skip and worth thousands. Geoffrey Munn finds a diamond pendant presented by the city of Liverpool, and there is some 1960s rock 'n roll memorabilia of the highest pedigree

programme.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Adventurer Simon Reeve sets out to travel around the coastline of the Indian Ocean, journeying by boat, car, train and plane as he takes in 16 countries. He starts on the tip of South Africa, where he dives with ragged-tooth sharks and joins conservationists helping to save the endangered African penguin, before heading into Cape Town, where he has a close encounter with a drug dealer. Moving on, he hitches a boat to Mozambique, where a nervous captain reveals the threat posed by Somali pirates, and completes this leg of his journey in Zanzibar, a tropical island steeped in the long history of the slave trade

programme.title: Scam Britain: Are You at Risk? - Tonight
programme.desc: With scams costing the UK public billions of pounds last year, they continue to pose a significant threat to many. With two thirds of people saying they live in fear of becoming a victim, what type of scams are being used, and how can viewers protect themselves? Paul Brand reports

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: Feeling increasingly isolated and deceived, Lexie is left with no choice but to agree to help crime boss Cal Morris with a secret business transaction. Later, a shock discovery then threatens the safety of Lexie's family and she's forced further into the criminal underbelly of Cal's empire

programme.title: Pictionary
programme.desc: Mel Giedroyc hosts the game show where two teams of three players compete against each other trying to guess the correct word or phrase represented by the drawings of their team-mates. Mel is joined by Denise Van Outen and Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen as the players draw and their team members guess

programme.title: Good Morning Britain
programme.desc: Morning magazine featuring a lively mix of news and current affairs, plus health, entertainment and lifestyle features

programme.title: Lorraine
programme.desc: Early morning chat show presented by Lorraine Kelly, with celebrity interviews, entertainment news, cooking tips, fashion features and musical guests

programme.title: This Morning
programme.desc: Daily magazine, featuring a mix of celebrity chat, showbusiness news, lifestyle features, topical discussion, health and beauty advice and more

programme.title: Loose Women
programme.desc: The women put the world to rights once more, discussing everything from politics to parenting, and invite a celebrity guest to chat about what they are up to - or anything else that takes their fancy

programme.title: ITV Lunchtime News; Weather
programme.desc: The key headlines from the day so far

programme.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
programme.desc: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: David Dickinson helps members of the public in Solihull sort the treasures from their trash. Henry Nicholls tries to get his hands on a military watch and Fay Rutter cannot believe her luck when she is faced with 35 sovereign coins. But how much is she willing to pay? Jan Keyne gets a lesson in profit-making and Simon Schneider gets an offer he can refuse

programme.title: Lingo
programme.desc: Hemel Hempstead husband and wife Hari and Rasika, Merseyside couple Kellie and Eric, and Northern Irish father and son Tony and Laurence use their powers of deduction to work out words that appear in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords. The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leaving with nothing. Adil Ray hosts

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Leah tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Mike, John, Amy and Sian pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught

programme.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
programme.desc: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world

programme.title: Can We Cure Dementia? Tonight
programme.desc: Dementia is now Britain's biggest killer. Unlike cancer, treatments have changed little in decades - until now. With two new drugs now proven to slow the disease - and another 158 currently being tested - Paul Brand follows one of the most anticipated medical trials, meeting patients and scientists hoping to be part of a breakthrough

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Steve continues to torment Kim, while Tom tears down his prison calendar and steps out of his cell, and Charity supports an anxious Belle

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: Bethany warns Kit against telling Sara their secret. Ross gets wind of Marco's plan to help him escape and Christina learns that Lucy will be moving into Number 11

programme.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
programme.desc: Ant and Dec reveal the previous day's events as contestants adjust to jungle life without familiar comforts, facing camp routines, uncertain meals and star-driven trials

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents

programme.title: ITV News Anglia; Weather
programme.desc: Breaking news and current stories from across the East of England

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: Action sequel starring Tom Cruise and Cobie Smulders. After being wrongly accused of murder, Jack Reacher goes on the run with Major Turner, who has been accused of selling government secrets. Can they clear their names before being caught?

programme.title: Cabaret
programme.desc: Bob Fosse's Oscar-winning musical drama, based on Christopher Isherwood's memoir, starring Liza Minnelli, Joel Grey and Michael York. A love affair develops between cabaret singer Sally Bowles and naive young Englishman Brian Roberts in the decadent Berlin of the 1930s, all while Nazism develops a steady grip on German society.

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Four chefs face an invention test in which pistachios take centre stage and serve a two-course meal that showcases their food, ideas and technical ability to food critics William Sitwell, Jimi Famurewa and Ixta Belfrage. Back in the kitchen, judges Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti decide who deserves a place in knockout week

programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin
programme.desc: Part one of two. In 1972, Ugandan dictator Idi Amin announced a plan to throw all Asians out of the east African country within 90 days in a bid to increase support for his regime. Priyanga Burford narrates this documentary charting the impact of the decree on the 80,000 people affected as they hoped to be able to flee on their British passports

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Cameras focus on entrepreneur Aoibheann, who has found the ideal location to retreat from her busy life in Galway - a modest derelict cottage in the heart of the Burren, Co Clare. Her creativity and plans for the residence know no bounds, but if she can't rein in some of her ideas, will this renovation ever progress?

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: An 'uninhabitable' house in Clackmannanshire and a Lincolnshire layout disaster need lots of work, whereas a Leicester flat is pretty much good to go

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul travel to Co Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Humanity's water supplies are shrinking amid climate change, population growth and poor management. Scarcity is displacing millions and could fuel conflicts. Hannah travels to Kenya to witness the crisis, and explores technologies offering ways to protect supplies and meet demand

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: The journalist in conversation with people who influence political thinking, talking about what has shaped theirs

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Quiz show hosted by Ross Kemp in which contestants compete for cash by crossing a bridge made up of stepping stones, each of which has a different option. Friends Catherine, Lisa, Michelle and Helen must try to get from A to B by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies in order to cross the studio floor safely, or risk falling off the bridge and out of the game

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman explore the Manchester Food and Drink Festival, meeting passionate producers of chilli sauce, Eritrean curries and Italian biscuits among the stalls. Onkar Singh Purewal discovers how it is possible to grow tea in the Vale of Glamorgan, while farmer Jim Smith gets stuck into some sticky sweets

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's rail trek along the coast of Northumberland continues towards the Farne Islands, takes in the holy island of Lindisfarne, and finishes in England's northernmost town, Berwick-upon-Tweed

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: Liz explores the South American coastline, one of the most populated regions of the Caribbean, and starts with her ancestral home of Trinidad and its carnival. Liz also searches for the rare white-fronted capuchin with the help of the Trinidad Field Naturalist Club, and finds out about the ancient tradition of keeping songbirds

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Montacute House in Somerset, where they value more objects brought in by the public. Among the items are chairs that were aboard one of Nelson's ships during the Battle of Trafalgar, and vintage underwear collected by a vicar's wife. First shown in 2006

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents as the team values antiques at the Museum of Science and Industry in Manchester. Anita Manning and Michael Baggott examine items including a French book of butterflies and an Inuit carving. Plus, a look at a rare and beautiful art book that is contested at auction

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Michael Sheen asks the questions as Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad battle it out to be crowned the week's winner

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is on hand with more exclusives as she's joined by a new all-star panel. Plus, there's a sneak peek at the couples' first rehearsals on the ballroom floor

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events with Matt Chorley

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin reveal why foxes' eyes shine in the dark, and how fish flatulence almost caused an international diplomatic incident. They also establish whether ivy really damages the trees it climbs, and exactly how sea anemones deliver their sting

programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Adam Frost shares practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months, from planting shrubs and creating a winter container to laying a brick path. In Hertfordshire, Ashley Edwards is given an exclusive tour of a stunning walled garden, while Rachel de Thame reveals her secrets for growing spectacular dahlias, and Joe Swift discovers an extraordinary garden in Dorset bursting with beauty and inspiring plant combinations.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Period epic starring Russell Crowe and Joaquin Phoenix. Rome, the second century AD: dying emperor Marcus Aurelius chooses the city's beloved general, Maximus Decimus Meridius, as his successor - a decision that results in a bitter power struggle with Aurelius's son Commodus, who sentences Maximus and his family to death. The general escapes, but he and Commodus are destined to meet again.

programme.title: Coriolanus
programme.desc: Contemporary update of Shakespeare's political drama, directed by and starring Ralph Fiennes, and featuring Gerard Butler and Brian Cox. Fearsome Roman general Caius Martius returns from a victorious campaign against his archenemy Tullus Aufidius and is awarded the title "Coriolanus" in recognition of his efforts. Urged on by his ambitious mother, Coriolanus seeks political office, but his failure to win the support of the masses soon leads him into exile and breeds a desire for vengeance on the city of Rome.

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc:
In our fields and hedgerows are plants that are delicious as well as plants that are deadly, as Rick learns from a professional forager who takes him on a tour around the beautiful Camel Estuary. Inspired, Rick creates his own version of a Greek Horta pie with foraged greens.
Afterwards, it's a trip down memory lane with his long-time fish supplier Matthew Stevens, who remembers Cornwall before the tourists came. Over a pint with actor, comedian and passionate Cornishman Ed Rowe, star of the BAFTA winning film Bait, Rick examines the impact of second home ownership on Cornish communities.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

Colin just cannot help himself and cheats when it looks like Eric is going to win a game of darts, and Beth gets caught in the middle. Comedy, starring Arabella Weir, Alex Norton, Doon Mackichan, Jonathan Watson, Elaine C Smith and Sharon Rooney

programme.title: Passenger

programme.title: Forbidden Fruits
programme.desc: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch coven with co-workers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin challenges their sisterhood, forcing the trio to confront their inner darkness. As tensions rise and the coven's secrets threaten to spill, they must face their fears or all meet a violent end. Comedy horror, starring Lili Reinhart

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After her husband dies, a grieving woman seeks comfort at her in-laws' secluded home. But a family gathering becomes a nightmare when the relatives are possessed. Romantic drama, starring Tamera Mowry-Housley and Kristoffer Polaha

Festive family comedy, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Rebel Wilson, Alice Eve and Danny Dyer

Comedy road movie, starring Steve Martin, John Candy, Laila Robins, Kevin Bacon and Michael McKean

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: Revenge thriller starring Joel Kinnaman. One Christmas Eve in a Texas town, Brian Godlock and his son are caught up in a drive-by shooting that leaves the boy dead and Brian unable to talk. Once out of hospital, he begins to gather the evidence and skills he needs to wreak vengeance on the gang that ruined his life.

programme.title: Mrs Santa Claus
programme.desc: Seasonal musical starring Angela Lansbury. In 1910, a bored Mrs Santa Claus takes her husband's sleigh for a spin and crash-lands in Manhattan's multicultural Lower East Side just before Christmas.

programme.title: All I Want for Christmas
programme.desc: A young girl with divorced parents, whose mother is about to remarry, asks Santa to bring them back together.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy starring Ben Affleck, James Gandolfini and Christina Applegate. Wealthy advertising executive Drew Latham faces Christmas alone after quarrelling with his girlfriend, so he decides to revisit his old childhood home, only to find it now occupied by the Valco family. Desperate for company, he pays the Valcos to let him spend the holiday season with them as their son. While dad Tom is happy to take the cash, the rest of the clan don't take too kindly to Drew's presence, especially daughter Alicia.

programme.title: Nativity 2: Danger in the Manger!
programme.desc: Comedy starring David Tennant and Jessica Hynes. Jingle bells give way to alarm bells when a hapless new teacher agrees to take the pupils of St Bernadette's to rural Wales to compete in a clash of the Christmas choirs. And it just so happens that his twin brother is conducting a rival group.

programme.title: Nativity 3: Dude, Where's My Donkey?!
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Clunes, Catherine Tate and Marc Wootton. When new teacher Mr Shepherd loses both his memory and Archie the school donkey, it's up Mr Poppy and the kids of St Bernadette's to find the animal and reunite their amnesiac tutor with his girlfriend in New York.

programme.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
programme.desc: A freelance reporter returns to Chicago for the holidays and is assigned to profile Darlene, a devoted Bears fan attending her 500th game. programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: Animated fantasy based on the book by Dr Seuss, featuring the voice of Benedict Cumberbatch. The embittered, mountain-dwelling Grinch plots to ruin the festive season for the cheery citizens of Whoville. That is until he finds his spirits unexpectedly lifted by a young girl and her family.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: Black comedy horror starring Zach Galligan and Phoebe Cates. In a small American town, kindly inventor Rand Peltzer brings home a cute little animal called a mogwai for his son Billy, with three rules for its upkeep: never get the mogwai wet, expose him to light or feed him after midnight. Accidentally, these rules get broken and all hell breaks loose.

programme.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy starring Jim Carrey. It's Christmas in Whoville and preparations are well under way. Meanwhile, up in his mountain lair, cold-hearted hermit the Grinch sits alone resenting the Whovians' happiness. But then he's befriended by a little girl.

programme.title: Christmas with the Kranks
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy starring Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis. After their daughter goes to Peru to serve with the Peace Corps, Luther and Nora Krank face their first Christmas alone. Miserable at the prospect, they decide to completely forget yuletide and go on a Caribbean cruise. But their change of plan doesn't go smoothly.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Seasonal comedy fantasy starring Will Ferrell and James Caan. Raised by Santa's helpers at the North Pole, human infant Buddy matures into a strapping adult and outgrows his cramped surroundings. His resultant determination to find his real father, Walter, sends Buddy on an exciting trip to New York.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Animated action adventure featuring the voices of Shameik Moore and Jake Johnson. Teenager Miles Morales is bitten by a radioactive arachnid and develops superhuman abilities like those of local hero Spider-Man. When Spidey is taken out of action by villain Kingpin, Miles must step up to prevent an unstable supercollider from sending New York into another dimension. But he soon finds he's not the only spider-being in town...

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Superhero adventure, starring Tobey Maguire, Willem Dafoe and Kirsten Dunst. During a school trip to a New York laboratory, Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically modified spider and develops extraordinary powers. Then a series of events convinces Peter that he should use his new physical abilities to wage war on crime - a decision that takes him away from his school sweetheart, Mary Jane Watson, and pits him against the evil Green Goblin.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Fantasy action sequel starring Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and Alfred Molina. Two years after walking away from his sweetheart Mary Jane, Peter Parker is struggling to balance his dual identities as a college student and mysterious superhero Spider-Man. He finds his life further complicated by the appearance of multi-tentacled villain Doctor Octopus...

However, when Parker discovers a local man is illegally selling alien technology, the nascent hero spies an opportunity to prove his world-saving worth.

As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Misguided inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that can turn water into food. But what initially seems like the answer to his community's economic crisis soon begins to cause some unexpected problems.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy with the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Flint Lockwood's mutating machine is no longer turning water into food but producing food/animal hybrids, or foodimals, which very quickly overrun his home town.

Hunted for his incredible powers, super speedy alien Sonic lives a lonely life in hiding on Earth. When he accidentally causes a power surge, Sonic is thrown into the orbit of kindly local sheriff Tom - but also that of unhinged scientist Dr Robotnik.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: The Wizard of Oz
programme.desc: Classic musical fantasy starring Judy Garland, Ray Bolger, Bert Lahr and Jack Haley. When a huge tornado hits Dorothy's home in Kansas, she is whisked off far away into a strange and dazzling world. There she must escape the clutches of the Wicked Witch of the West and find her way to the Emerald City.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, George Clooney, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell. Called to the Gotham City Museum of Art where Mr Freeze and his gang are in the process of stealing a huge diamond, Batman and Robin are thwarted in their attempts to stop the heist when the Boy Wonder is frozen by the villains.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Period horror adventure starring Brendan Fraser and Jet Li. Intrepid explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell come out of retirement to join their archaeologist son Alex in a race to prevent the resurrected Dragon Emperor and his terracotta army from taking over the world.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Past experience tells Dr Ian Malcolm not to get involved with businessman John Hammond's new scheme to build a dinosaur park. However, he reluctantly agrees when he realises that his girlfriend is already on site. On his arrival on the secluded island he soon finds that his fears were well founded.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his billionaire industrialist boss, Cole Reed is framed for the crime and forced to go on the run as he uncovers an international conspiracy. Thriller, starring Jason Statham, Chaneil Kular and Ramon Tikaram

programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Hamlet's father is dead, poisoned by his uncle who has usurped the throne. When the dead King's ghost appears, commanding his son to revenge his most unnatural murder, Hamlet is set on a course of action that can only end in the destruction of a dynasty.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Arnold Schwarzenegger as tough Los Angeles cop John Kimble, who's facing the greatest challenge of his career - going under cover as a kindergarten teacher to track down the family of a vicious mobster.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Spoof western starring Cleavon Little and Gene Wilder. Sheriff Bart fights prejudice and corruption to save the little town of Rock Ridge from wicked speculator Hedley Lamarr, helped by the once legendary Waco Kid.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles
programme.desc: A teenager's parents forget her birthday, so she tries to get over her disappointment by searching for the man of her dreams, unaware she's looking in the wrong place. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald, Justin Henry and Anthony Michael Hall

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: A New York actor's difficult reputation has rendered him unemployable. When a TV soap advertises a new female role, he disguises himself as a woman for the audition - and wins the part. But the character proves so popular, he is forced to keep up the pretence indefinitely. Comedy, starring Dustin Hoffman, Jessica Lange and Bill Murray. Directed by Sydney Pollack, who makes a cameo appearance as Hoffman's agent

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.desc: As King Jaffe Joffer, ruler of the prosperous nation of Zamunda, takes his final breath, pampered crown prince Akeem faces a constitutional crisis without a male heir to ascend the throne. An elderly shaman unexpectedly discloses that Akeem has an illegitimate son in New York. Comedy, starring Eddie Murphy and Arsenio Hall

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.
