programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Friends Mia and Mel run their own beauty company. However, things take a turn for the worse when their business runs into a massive amount of debt. They are forced to turn to ruthless benefactor Claire Luna, head of a major cosmetics empire, who intends to steal the business from under them. Comedy, starring Tiffany Haddish, Rose Byrne and Salma Hayek

programme.title: Dumb and Dumber
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels. When limousine driver Lloyd Christmas gets the sack, he persuades his roommate Harry Dunne to drive him to Aspen in pursuit of an attractive woman passenger who left a briefcase behind. The daft duo embark on a variety of adventures before discovering the briefcase is full of dollar bills.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Samuel L Jackson, Vanessa Williams, Jeffrey Wright and Christian Bale. Two years after a murder suspect skipped bail, detective John Shaft is given a second opportunity to get his man. But the path to justice is blocked by a ruthless drug baron intent on murdering the only witness to the crime.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime drama starring Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Andy Garcia and Robert De Niro. Determined young federal agent Eliot Ness leads a tough team of investigators in a dangerous mission to end Al Capone's violent reign of terror in Prohibition-era Chicago.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on Ronald Harwood's play, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Tom Courtenay and Billy Connolly. At the Beecham House retirement home for opera singers, the occasion of Verdi's birthday is always marked by a special fundraising concert. But this year the arrival of one particular grande dame throws preparations into chaos as egos clash and old resentments surface.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on Ronald Harwood's play, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Tom Courtenay and Billy Connolly. At the Beecham House retirement home for opera singers, the occasion of Verdi's birthday is always marked by a special fundraising concert. But this year the arrival of one particular grande dame throws preparations into chaos as egos clash and old resentments surface.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Natalie Portman and Peter Sarsgaard. A week after the assassination of her husband, President John F Kennedy, a shell-shocked Jackie is interviewed by a journalist, and is forced to relive the events leading up to the most horrific moment of her life.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
programme.desc: In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal. Romantic drama, starring Joely Richardson, Joanne Froggatt and Paul Giamatti

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy sequel starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Sigourney Weaver and Harold Ramis. The Ghostbusters are reunited when their old client Dana Barrett calls for help. Now a single parent with an eight-month-old baby son, she is once again having problems with supernatural phenomena.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Aaron Eckhart and Hilary Swank. When the Earth's core stops rotating, mankind suffers a series of disasters, including devastating electrical storms and exposure to solar radiation. A top team of scientists is assembled to design and pilot a machine to burrow to the centre of the Earth and set the core spinning again.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from the director of The Shape of Water, starring Charlie Hunnam and Idris Elba. In an epic war between colossal monsters from under the sea and gigantic human-controlled robots, it's up to two unlikely heroes to save mankind.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Idris Elba. Three years into its five-year mission, the USS Enterprise stops off at a remote outpost for maintenance and provisions. There the crew answer a distress call from a stranded ship, but they are attacked by an army of unknown aliens that overwhelms the Enterprise.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring Harrison Ford and Ryan Gosling. Los Angeles blade runner Officer K uncovers a shocking secret that puts him on the trail of Rick Deckard, who has been missing for 30 years. Meanwhile, corporate magnate Niander Wallace seeks the truth about so-called replicant reproduction in order to further his plans for interstellar colonisation.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Vince Vaughn and Kathryn Newton. Unpopular high-school student Millie unexpectedly switches bodies with a local serial killer, known as the "Blissfield Butcher". Now trapped in the body of a hulking 50-something man, Millie must find a way to swap back - and prevent the killer from continuing his spree under her name.

programme.title: Zola
programme.desc: Black comedy drama based on a true story, starring Taylour Paige and Riley Keough. Zola, a Detroit waitress who works part-time as a stripper, befriends fellow dancer Stefani, who invites her along to a supposedly lucrative job in Florida. However, after arriving in Tampa, things take a turn for the chaotic when Zola discovers that she and Stefani are being pimped out for sex.

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny
programme.desc: Courtroom drama based on Herman Wouk's Pulitzer Prize-winning novel, starring Humphrey Bogart as martinet skipper Philip Queeg who's put in charge of the naval minesweeper Caine. But the strain of maintaining discipline among his restless crew begins to affect his ability to command.

programme.title: To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Biographical war drama starring Audie Murphy. Having spent his childhood in poverty in Texas, young Audie Murphy is turned down as physically unsuitable by the marines and the US Navy. Undeterred, he fights on to become the most decorated American soldier in the Second World War.

programme.title: Anne of the Thousand Days
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Richard Burton and Geneviève Bujold. Henry VIII discards his first wife, Catherine of Aragon, for the pretty young Anne Boleyn. Their courtship lasts six years while Henry awaits a divorce. But when their eventual marriage can only produce a daughter and no son and heir, Henry uses this as an excuse to rid himself of his second wife by execution.

Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc:
Steve and crew pitch up in British Columbia, Canada. It is an explorer's paradise with infinite untouched wilderness and spectacular animals, but Steve's focus is on the creatures of the deep. In the giant underwater kelp forests lurks a swimming giant - the wolf eel. This monster strikes fear into some of the world's spiniest creatures, biting clean through their defensive spikes with ferocious chisel-like teeth and powerful jaws - not a surprising achievement when you consider that its head is the size of a football.
Steve then finds a trail of discarded crab shells which leads him on to his next deadly encounter - an eight-legged sea creature which can easily reach the size of a family-sized tent. Armed with a vicious biting beak, the giant Pacific octopus makes light work of a crab's shell, and Steve comes face to face with one and quite literally gets wrapped up in his encounter with it. It has an extraordinary arm span and is a crab killer without equal.
Then Steve is off in search of what could arguably be the most deadly animal in the world. Called wolves of the water - not only because they have a mouthful of killer teeth but because they hunt in packs - they are orcas, otherwise known as killer whales. One of the most awesome predators on the planet, they have it all - size, speed and power. When Steve goes kayaking in amongst them, he gets the surprise of his life when they start breaching all around him.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc:
Whilst watching Flutter surf, the Piripenguins notice Looph behaving in an odd, almost mechanical fashion. Afterwards, Flutter inadvertently knocks Looph's head off with his surfboard. Everyone stares in horror, before noticing wires emerging. "Shrimps alive!" cries Brinicle, "Looph is a robot!". The real Looph turns up and explains: she is due to give a science speech but, feeling nervous, has invented a robot version of herself, Looph 2.0, to stand in. Her friends are dismayed. Looph doesn't realise how talented she is. They need to help her do the speech herself! Brinicle takes Looph off to learn to 'project' her voice by bouncing it off the surrounding mountain peaks. But Looph is so quiet that her voice just disappears. Brinicle demonstrates with a yodel. His voice pleasingly reverberates around them. Looph copies but her yodel is followed by a rumble that grows and grows, until an avalanche rains down around them.
Nugget meanwhile wants to help Looph get fit for her speech with an 'easy 10-mile run'. Poor Looph pants and wheezes as she trails Nugget, who shouts encouraging platitudes. Next comes a fierce staring contest with Flutter to practice 'holding the audience's attention'. Finally, Looph shows some promise - right before toppling off her stool! All that remains is Pancake's advice which is about adding pizazz: "Why not start with a joke?' he helpfully suggests, 'Or maybe a dance?' The Piri friends are excited to see the results of their coaching, so when Looph takes her seat next to them later at the theatre they're confused. Who is giving the speech? 'Well, who do you think' replies Looph as her robot counterpart rolls onto the stage. She thanks her kind friends. They really succeeded in showing her she's not equipped for this at all! And delivers with beautiful projection... a joke: "How do Earth, Venus and Saturn throw a party? They plan-et!" The Piris fall about laughing. Looph grins and launches confidently into her talk. programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc:
Tha Hari air mìlsean bhlasta a bhèiceadh airson Ela agus Seren - cèic teòclaid! Bidh aon Abadas air a thaghadh airson a dhol a shealltainn airson rudeigin eile cruinn agus milis. Dè bhios ann?
Hari has prepared a yummy treat for Ela and Seren - a chocolate cake! One Abadas will be chosen to go on another exciting adventure looking for something round and sweet-smelling. What could it be?

programme.title: Losgannan/Froglets
programme.desc:
Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a' dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich.
Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc:
Tha Mossy air bhioran gus a charaid ùr, Fred, a thoirt gu cruinneachaidh-cluich an sgioba. Ge-tà 's e deargann a th' ann am Fred 's chan eil càch cho toilichte a leithid fhaicinn nam measg... gus an seall Fred g' eil e feumail na dhòigh fhèin!
Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today's playdate, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea! However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean (Puffin Rock)
programme.desc:
Tha bràmair aig Bernie 's tha i gus tighinn gu dìnnear a-nochd! Ge-tà, chan eil dad a dh'fhios aig Bernie dè chuireas e air dòigh! Tha Oona 's Baba ag aontachadh a chuideachadh ach, le Mossy nam meag, saoil am bi biadh air fhàgail mus nochd i?
Bernie has a girlfriend - and she's on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her! Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc:
Feumaidh an Dùd Beag a bhith far an urrainn dha bhith dùdach fad' an là. Gu mì-fhortanach, chaidh e air seachran ach fhuair e a shlighe dhachaidh gu Planaid nan Dùd, le beagan taic bho a charaidean ùra
Little Dùd needs to be where he can hoot all day. Unfortunately, he goes missing but finds his way back home to Planet Dùd, with a little help from his new friends.

Tha Mgr. Crùbag a' cur Laraidh os cionn an taigh-bìdh rè ùine.

programme.desc: Mrs MacArthur unearths a new talent in her art class. Mr Hobson is not so sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that's behind the artwork. Meanwhile, Mr Mackle is busy with a new health kick

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc:
Tha Olaidh agus Coinneach ann an Ruisia agus chan e dìreach sgìtheadh a tha a' gabhail àite oir tha sinn a' faicinn tanca, saighdearan a' caismeachd agus.... geama leigeil-shaighdear?
Olaidh and Coinneach are in Russia but skiing isn't the only thing that's going on - there's a tank to be seen, soldiers marching and....a game of skittles?

programme.title: Belle agus Sebastian

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc:
Le beathaichean Tuathanas Mossybottom a' coimhead geama ping pong eadar Seonaidh agus Bitzer, chan eil iad a' mothachadh gu bheil sionnach acrach a' dabhdail timcheall.
With the animals of Mossybottom Farm keenly watching Shaun v Bitzer in the greatest table tennis match of all time, they fail to notice a hungry fox who isn't keeping his eye on the ball at all.

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:

In Gaelic with English subtitles

In Scotland, reporter Paul Colgan meets farmer Debbie Duffus, as she is reunited with the air ambulance team members who saved her life after a brutal farm accident

Golfing pals Linda and Yvonne are on the red team, guided by Caroline Hawley, and are soon eyeing up a pair of powder flasks

As time runs out, Rose, Raj and Joe must pool their findings to identify the burnt remains, track down the arsonist and expose the motive behind the blaze

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jonnie Irwin takes in the delights of Derbyshire with a couple from Leeds who are keen to see a range of properties with all the trimmings. Jonnie also visits a local cafe where customers take household items to be repaired rather throwing them away

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay head to Musselburgh, on Scotland's east coast. It's a town boasting a proud heritage that is celebrated each year with a procession led by their elected Honest Lad and Honest Lass. However, for the past few years, the antique carriage these local luminaries ride in has been off the road. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors

programme.title: The Finish Line

The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay head to Musselburgh, on Scotland's east coast. It's a town boasting a proud heritage that is celebrated each year with a procession led by their elected Honest Lad and Honest Lass. However, for the past few years, the antique carriage these local luminaries ride in has been off the road. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love a good game of 'Grannies', hobbling about on canes and causing mischief. But when Bingo does the floss dance, Bluey insists that it's definitely not something Grannies do. Unable to agree, they video call Nana who gives it her best shot. But she just can't do it. Bluey revels in her victory a little too much, and a sad Bingo quits their game. When Mum tells Bluey, she has to choose between being right or keeping Bingo happy, Bluey finds a third option - teaching Nana how to floss! Under Bluey's instruction, Nana becomes a flossing expert and Bingo is soon back in the game.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey, Bingo and their young friend Missy turn the hammock swing at the playground into a pirate ship, Mum narrates as Dad whips up a wild storm. But it all proves too much for Missy who gets scared and abandons ship. Mum can't persuade Missy to conquer her fears and re-join them, especially when Bluey and Bingo are swallowed by a big blue Daddy whale. But when Missy has an idea to save her friends in the whale's stomach, she digs deep, finds her courage and jumps on board, ready to tickle the beast and free her shipmates. And Dad obliges and spits them all up, ready for more adventures.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When mum goes for a walk by herself along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her, keen to share a shell she has found. Pretending to be a mermaid who has finally got her legs for the day, she embarks on a precious solo adventure, following Mum's footprints along the shoreline. Along the way she encounters a surfer, some pesky seagulls, a cast of crabs, a washed-up jellyfish and a rather large and nervous pelican. Having experienced what it's like to be on your own for the first time, Bluey reunites with Mum and they listen to the shell, before walking back down the beach together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's a rainy day, and Bluey has set up a taxi service inside. Her first fare is a stressed-out businessman (Dad) who needs to get to the airport immediately! Bluey assures him there will be no delays, but then immediately picks up passenger number two, a rich lady (Bingo) and her child, Millicent (Floppy). Between the roundabout directions of the SATNAV (Mum), Millicent vomiting all over him and the taxi finally breaking down, Dad decides to head to the airport on foot. He boards the plane in the nick of time, only to discover that the other passenger is the rich lady and the pilot is Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As Dad takes Bluey and Bingo on an early morning wagon ride to the park, Bluey can't wait to get to her beloved monkey bars. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat to his friends. Frustrated, Bluey keeps interrupting the grown-ups' conversations. Dad instructs her to be polite but it's not until she observes Bingo playing happily that Bluey sees she can play her own games along the way too. The next time Dad stops to chat near a bus stop, Bluey creates her own bus game with Bingo, roping Dad in to play. No longer in a big rush, Bluey learns to relax and enjoy the journey.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: A simple game of 'shops' between Bluey and her friends becomes impossible as no one can agree on who's who and what the rules are! Who's in charge of the checkout? What are they paying with? Who gets to be a kitten? Between Bluey's wanting people to wait and the switching around of her friend's roles, they'll never get started! Mackenzie soon gets fed up with the delays and quits, causing Bluey to reach out and apologize, agreeing that they'll start listening and not to be too impatient with each other from now on. United once more, they are finally able to open their imaginary shop's doors.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As Mum packs everyone's things for a trip to the pool without her, Bluey and Dad tease her about being so over-prepared. But when they arrive, they quickly discover that they've forgotten to bring the bag she packed! Bingo doesn't have her floaties, Bluey doesn't have her goggles and there are no towels! Stuck in the ever-shrinking shady bits (as the sunscreen was in the bag too) and with no morning tea to eat, Dad and the kids are about to give up on the day. But when Mum heroically arrives with all the missing stuff, they learn that sometimes you need a little planning to have a lot of fun.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While having a picnic in the park, Bluey, Bingo and Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets. Big Sister, Little Sister, and Little Fairy walk their fingers on an adventure beyond the Blue Mountains. Big Sister is hesitant to climb up such a steep hill, but Little Sister's enthusiasm is infectious as they reach the top and slide down the other side. There they encounter a cheeky fox who traps Big Sister in his cave. Finally, Little Sister saves the day, and leads them all to safety and the softest beds in the world.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: With a five dollar bill from the tooth fairy, Bluey is thrilled to go to the local markets with Dad to spend her money! But as she explores the market stalls with her friend Indy, committing to a purchase proves harder and harder. With everything from horse rides to poffertjes on offer, the choices are overwhelming! Following a panicked impulse buy, Bluey regrets she won't be able to buy a song from a busker. But Indy's assurance that 'what goes around comes around' rings true as the five dollar bill travels it's way around the market and gives Bluey a second chance.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo fail to win a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum tries to cheer them up by creating their own version at home. Dad tempts Bluey to try for a shot at winning a 'bottomless bowl of ice-cream', but only if Bingo sacrifices her most beloved toy. Close to victory at last, Dad's Claw malfunctions! Fed up, everyone takes matters into their own hands and tickles Dad until he gives up their prizes.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Colin Firth, Samuel L Jackson and Taron Egerton. A tearaway street kid is recruited to join a shadowy secret organisation. But even before he's earned his stripes, he's pitched into a battle to save the planet from domination by a criminal mastermind.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Vince Vaughn and Kathryn Newton. Unpopular high-school student Millie unexpectedly switches bodies with a local serial killer, known as the "Blissfield Butcher". Now trapped in the body of a hulking 50-something man, Millie must find a way to swap back - and prevent the killer from continuing his spree under her name.

programme.title: Zola
programme.desc: Black comedy drama based on a true story, starring Taylour Paige and Riley Keough. Zola, a Detroit waitress who works part-time as a stripper, befriends fellow dancer Stefani, who invites her along to a supposedly lucrative job in Florida. However, after arriving in Tampa, things take a turn for the chaotic when Zola discovers that she and Stefani are being pimped out for sex.

programme.title: The Caine Mutiny
programme.desc: Courtroom drama based on Herman Wouk's Pulitzer Prize-winning novel, starring Humphrey Bogart as martinet skipper Philip Queeg who's put in charge of the naval minesweeper Caine. But the strain of maintaining discipline among his restless crew begins to affect his ability to command.

programme.title: To Hell and Back
programme.desc: Biographical war drama starring Audie Murphy. Having spent his childhood in poverty in Texas, young Audie Murphy is turned down as physically unsuitable by the marines and the US Navy. Undeterred, he fights on to become the most decorated American soldier in the Second World War.

programme.title: Anne of the Thousand Days
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Richard Burton and Geneviève Bujold. Henry VIII discards his first wife, Catherine of Aragon, for the pretty young Anne Boleyn. Their courtship lasts six years while Henry awaits a divorce. But when their eventual marriage can only produce a daughter and no son and heir, Henry uses this as an excuse to rid himself of his second wife by execution.

programme.title: Sister Act 2: Back in the Habit
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Whoopi Goldberg as Las Vegas singer Deloris Van Cartier, who is persuaded once again to don the habit and help some of her nun friends save their run-down school from closure.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now
programme.desc: Epic war drama starring Martin Sheen, Marlon Brando and Robert Duvall. In Vietnam, war-weary Captain Willard is drawn into a nightmarish world when he is ordered to assassinate a rebel American officer, Colonel Kurtz, who has established his own private army deep in the Cambodian jungle.

Charlie Ross monitors progress and also visits nearby Lullingstone Castle, former site of the UK's first silk farm, to learn about some unusual former residents

programme.title: Celebrity Scam Interceptors
programme.desc: Amanda Holden joins the team for a special episode for Scam Safe Week, in which she helps them go after the criminals who used her name and image to con victims out of thousands. Using the same remote access tech scammers rely on, the team will hack the hackers to monitor their operations in real time, before confronting the fraudsters, and stopping scams before they happen

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When Phil returns home to find someone hanging around his house, he decides to confront him and finds some incriminating evidence on his doorbell footage. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan takes a trip to a garden centre to highlight simple tips that can deter wannabe burglars. And Janet turns doorbell detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Tess, Stuart, Eileen, Mel and Dan race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Hugh Dennis

In our fields and hedgerows are plants that are delicious as well as plants that are deadly, as Rick learns from a professional forager who takes him on a tour around the beautiful Camel Estuary. Inspired, Rick creates his own version of a Greek Horta pie with foraged greens.

To make matters worse, Susan turns up and the Harpers end up getting trapped in the department store overnight. Meanwhile, Janey, Michael and Alfie decide to give Susan and Ben a thoughtful present for a change, but despite their best efforts, it does not turn out quite as planned. programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: In March 2015, football fan Simon Dobbin was at an away game when he was set upon by a gang of men in an unprovoked attack that left him brain damaged, paralysed and unable to walk and talk. After many months in hospital he is finally back at home in Mildenhall, Suffolk, where he receives round-the-clock care from wife Nicole. But the family home is unfit for Simon's care and rehabilitation - so that's where Nick Knowles, designer Laurence Llewelyn- Bowen and the DIY SOS team come in, strengthened by a number of local tradesmen

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles and the team travel to Hessle, near Hull in East Yorkshire, to transform the home of Darren Hudson, who was left paralysed from the waist down due to a spinal cord injury. After three months of hospital rehabilitation, Darren returned home to his family, but tragedy struck again eight days later when his wife Sarah died suddenly. Since that moment, Darren and his three sons have been living in emotional trauma, with the wheelchair-using dad now the main carer for the family
